name: Rocco Arena, b. 20 December 1861
father: Francesco Antonio Arena, 42, marinaro, son of Filippo
note: Declared 23 December 1861 at Scilla, Distretto di Reggio, by the father. Witnesses Giuseppe Idone, 64, and Francesco Antonio Poli, 70, proprietario; parish note records the baptism on the 23rd. Gives THREE generations: Filippo Arena, his son Francesco Antonio (b. c.1819), and Rocco. CONFLICTS WITH THE TREE, which makes Rocco the son of Orazio Arena and Giovana Zirilli. The 1861 register holds only one Rocco Arena.

name: Giovanni Polistena, b. 16 September 1883
note: Born at half past nine in the evening at Via Grotte 47, Scilla; declared next morning by the father before Minasi Raffaele, assessore. The father's name AGREES with the tree's "Antonio Polistena" and dates him to about 1835. The mother does NOT: the register says Giovanna ROMANO, the tree says Giovanna PONTILLO. The tree also gives that Giovanna Pontillo two parents both surnamed Pontillo, which looks like an error in the tree rather than a second marriage.

name: Arena Domenica
note: Another Arena birth at Scilla in 1861, not in the family tree. Parentage not read.

name: Domenico-Giovanni-Camillo Arena, b. 24 April 1870
mother: Serafina Vita di Giovanni, 20, donna di casa
note: Born at twelve o'clock Italian time on 24 April 1870 at Centro Acquagrande, Scilla; declared the same day at sixteen hours before Pasquale Florio, sindaco. Witnesses Giuseppe Idone fu Rocco, 72, and Candeloro Ciccone di Domenico, 30, servienti. The act carries its own correction clause -- 'la parola interlineata Domenico deve leggersi Giuseppe' -- and is signed by the father. Volume cited by its dam-antenati container wWqVnPB (Scilla 1870, 67 images), image 19; the ark for this volume was not captured. Gives THREE Arena generations: Domenico Arena, his son Giuseppe (b. c.1840, a ropemaker -- not a sea trade), and this boy. The mother's surname VITA is confirmed as a Scilla surname by the 1913 marriage index, which has three Vita entries and no Sita. The marginal ANNOTAZIONE records that he married at Scilla on 30 November 1899 to Arena Maria, born there in 1869 (birth act 166 of 1869), marriage act 62 -- and it calls him ARENA DOMENICO, not Giovanni. Naming custom agrees: Domenico was his paternal grandfather and Giovanni his maternal one, so Domenico was the name he carried. That, plus the wife (the tree gives Giovanni Arena b.1870 a wife Concetta Russo), argues this is probably NOT the tree's man. He is recorded here as the only Arena boy born at Scilla in 1870 with Giovanni among his names, not as an identification.

name: Giuseppe Arena, b. 6 October 1892
note: Born at 11.30 in the morning of 6 October 1892 in the house at VIA GROTTE 75, Scilla; declared at 10.15 on 9 October by the father before Minasi Luigi, assessore funzionante da sindaco. Witness Perina. Container 5Yb6no7, image 79, act 230. This is the single most useful act the Scilla sweep has produced. It CONFIRMS the tree on two points -- Giuseppe Arena b.1892 and his mother CONCETTA RUSSO -- and CORRECTS it on a third: Giovanni Arena is thirty-three in October 1892, so he was born about 1859, not 1870 as the tree has it. That in turn EXCLUDES Domenico-Giovanni-Camillo Arena (act 81 of 1870) as the tree's Giovanni. It also gives Giovanni a trade -- PESCATORE, a fisherman -- and an address on the same street where Giovanni Polistena was born in 1883, Via Grotte.

name: Domenico Arena, b. 10 February 1859
note: From the Bourbon-era Tavola annuale alfabetica, which names both parents on the same ruled line as the child -- read here from the WHOLE uncropped page, so the alignment is directly visible and not inferred. Container 5vEYzey, image 156. THIS IS THE COUPLE THE TREE NAMES AS ROCCO ARENA'S PARENTS and which this archive had been unable to find in any register. Orazio Arena and Giovanna Zirilli were real, at Scilla, and having children in 1859. It does NOT make Rocco their son -- the 1861 register's only Rocco Arena belongs to Francesco Antonio Arena and Serafina Arlotta -- but it converts the tree's claim from unsupported to half-supported, and it makes a wrong YEAR for Rocco the likely explanation rather than wrong parents.

name: Maria Arena, b. 1 May 1859
note: Second of three Arena births at Scilla in 1859. Not in the family tree.

name: Annunziato Arena, b. 15 September 1859
note: Third of three Arena births at Scilla in 1859. Not in the family tree. NOTE: the 1892 birth index has an Arena Giovanna di Annunziato at act 222, which would make her this man's daughter.

name: GIOVANNI ARENA — SOUGHT, NOT FOUND
note: The 1859 A section holds exactly three Arena births -- Domenico, Maria and Annunziato -- and no Giovanni. Act 230 of 1892 makes Giovanni thirty-three in October 1892, so born between about October 1858 and October 1859; 1858 (an_ua2002925) is therefore the next volume to open, and ages in these acts are loose enough that 1857 and 1860 stay in range.

name: MICHELE DONATO — SOUGHT, NOT FOUND
note: The D section of the 1851 Tavola runs entries 65 to 75 -- seven Di Franco, two Dormi, one De Marco, one De Alessandro -- with the last C at 64 and the first F at 76, so the block is complete. No Donato. His eldest recorded son was born 1878, putting his own birth around 1848-1858.

name: Annunziata Donato, b. 6 July 1892
note: Born at half past four in the afternoon of 6 July 1892 in the house at VIA GROTTE 31, Scilla; declared next morning at 9.15 by the father before D'Amico Gaetano, assessore delegato. Witnesses Arlotta Giuseppe, 56, pescatore, and Ponte Antonio, 38, pescatore. Container 5Yb6no7, image 56, act 162. Reached without a single extra portal page load: the volume was already open for act 230, and a child's act names the father with an age. CONFIRMS the mother MARIA SOFI and the birth date the tree gives. CORRECTS the father: Michele Donato is thirty-six in July 1892, so born about 1856, not 1851 -- which is why the 1851 index had no Donato in it. Gives him a trade the tree does not: PESCATORE. The marginal annotation adds a death the tree has no record of at all -- Annunziata Donato died at Scilla on 26 AUGUST 1975, death act 30 of that year.

name: Anna Arena, b. 17 January 1893
note: Born at a quarter past four in the morning of 17 January 1893 at VIA ACQUAGRANDE 41, Scilla; declared on the 19th before Minasi Raffaele, sindaco. Container w9WVxa9, image 9. The declarant is NOT the father but GIOVANNA ZUMBO, 60, LEVATRICE -- the midwife -- which is why the act carries no age for Rocco Arena and so does not settle his birth year. It does confirm the tree exactly on the date and on the mother GENEROSA COSTA, and it gives Rocco a trade: MARINARO, a sailor. That last fact cuts against the archive's working hypothesis rather than for it: the Rocco Arena of act 228 of 1861 is the son of FRANCESCO ANTONIO ARENA, also a marinaro, and trades passed from father to son. The address matters too -- this Arena household is at ACQUAGRANDE, not at Via Grotte where Giovanni Arena's household is. Two Arena families, two quarters of the town, whose children Giuseppe and Anna married each other.

name: Domenico Arena, b. 3 September 1856
note: From the Tavola annuale alfabetica for 1856, which is bound as a SEPARATE VOLUME (an_ua2002920, container 04rZDNY, 34 images, index at images 26-32) from the acts themselves (an_ua2002917, container wR8JBDp, 107 images ending at act 200 with no index). A SECOND son named Domenico to the same couple, three years before act 46 of 1859 -- so the first child almost certainly died in infancy and the name was reused, which was ordinary practice. It confirms Orazio Arena and Giovanna Zirilli as a couple having children at Scilla through the 1850s.

name: ROCCO ARENA di ORAZIO — SOUGHT, NOT FOUND
note: The complete A section of the 1856 Tavola holds nine entries: Arena Francesca (28, of Giosafatto e Longordo Rosaria), Arlotta Maria Concetta (75), Arlotta Rocco (83), Arbitrio Domenico (128), Arbitrio Francesco (141), Amendola Francesco (158), ARENA DOMENICO (180, of Orazio e Zirilli Giovanna), Arbitrio Domenico (175), Alfonzetti Concetta (238). No Rocco Arena of any parentage. With 1859 also checked, Orazio's Rocco is not in either year.

name: MICHELE DONATO — SOUGHT, NOT FOUND
note: The complete D section of the 1856 Tavola: Denisi Santa (24), Difranco Nunzia (36), Dormi Mariana (54), Dormi Giuseppe (91), D'Elia Giovanni (105), De Nava Vittoria (200), Difranco Pasquale (204), Difranco Serafino (207), Difranco Rocco (225), Difranco Santo (230), Difranco Grazia (233), De Marco Antonino (235). Bounded by the last C at 237 above and the first F at 3 below. NO DONATO.

name: MICHELE DONATO — SOUGHT, NOT FOUND
note: The complete D section of the 1859 Tavola: De Franco Pasquale (73), De Ciccio Rocco (120), De Elia M. Teresa (127), De Franco Rocco (138), De Franco Grazia (160), Dormi Antonia (166), Dormi Concetta (168), De Franco Rocc'Antonio (196), De Franco Rosa (221), D'Ignoto Domenico (275). Bounded by C above and F below. NO DONATO. That is now THREE years -- 1851, 1856, 1859 -- across the whole window his daughter's act allows, with no Donato birth at Scilla in any of them.

name: GIUSEPPI POLISTENA — SOUGHT, NOT FOUND
note: 1875 is another doubled year where the two arks are NOT two halves: an_ua16601237 (container 5K7aGNQ, 57 images) holds Parte I and Parte II acts with no index; an_ua16601238 (container w9WVGVa, 37 images) carries the INDICE ANNUALE at images 34-37. The complete P section holds exactly two Polistena: POLISTENA VITTORIA di Francesco (act 119) and POLISTINA GIOVANNI di Salvatore (act 235). NEITHER is a child of Camillo Antonio Polistena, and there is no Giuseppe. The tree's Giuseppi Polistena b.1875 is therefore not born at Scilla in 1875 -- and the Ellis Island manifest of 12 August 1903 makes him thirty, so about 1873. Next volume to open is 1873 (an_ua16601235). The same P section also carries PONTILLO Annunziato di Domenico (act 131), which confirms Pontillo as a genuine Scilla surname -- so the tree's 'Giovanna Pontillo' is at least a plausible name, even though act 206 of 1883 says the mother was Giovanna ROMANO.

name: Rocco Arena, b. 23 April 1858
note: From the Tavola annuale, container wQYJdjz, index at images 119-124. THE ONLY ARENA BIRTH AT SCILLA IN 1858, and it is a Rocco -- which matters, because it means the Rocco Arena of act 228 of 1861 is NOT the only candidate of roughly the right age. His parents are Santo Arena and Giovanna Gioffre, the same couple who appear again at act 205 of 1859 with a son Annunziato. The Ellis Island manifest makes our Rocco thirty-nine in March 1900: this one would be forty-one, the 1861 one thirty-eight. Thirty-eight is the closer fit and the tree independently says 1861, but the archive can no longer say there is only one Rocco Arena to choose from.

name: GIOVANNI ARENA — SOUGHT, NOT FOUND
note: The complete A section of the 1858 Tavola holds eleven entries and exactly one Arena -- Rocco, act 60. No Giovanni. With 1859 also checked, Giovanni Arena is in neither of the two years his son's act points to. 1857 (an_ua2002922) and 1860 (an_ua2002931) remain.

name: Giuseppe Arena, b. 5 March 1860
note: Tavola annuale, container wr9rbv8, index at images 136-142. THE DECISIVE ACT. Francesco Antonio Arena and Serafina Arlotta -- the couple of act 228 of 1861 -- have a son GIUSEPPE in March 1860 and a son ROCCO in December 1861. The family tree gives ORAZIO ARENA exactly two children, and they are ROCCO and GUISEPPE. The tree has taken Francesco Antonio's household and hung it on Orazio.

name: Maria Annunziata Arena, b. 27 August 1860
note: Orazio Arena and Giovanna Zirilli's THIRD documented child, after Domenico in 1856 and Domenico in 1859. Across four years now read -- 1856, 1858, 1859, 1860 -- their children are Domenico, Domenico and Maria Annunziata. NO ROCCO AND NO GIUSEPPE. The index gives her mother as Zirilli MARIA Giovanna, a fuller form of the name.

name: Domenico Arena, b. 2 March 1860
note: A GIOVANNI ARENA fathering a child at Scilla in 1860 -- so an adult, born in the 1830s, and not the Giovanni Arena this archive is looking for (born about 1859). Recorded so the two are not confused.

name: GIOVANNI ARENA and ROCCO ARENA — SOUGHT, NOT FOUND
note: The complete A section of the 1860 Tavola holds ten entries and four Arena: Domenico (43), Giuseppe (45), Maria Annunziata (161) and no others. NO Giovanni born, NO Rocco born. Giovanni Arena is now absent from 1858, 1859 and 1860 -- all three years his son's act allows. 1857 (an_ua2002922) remains, after which the likeliest explanation is that he was born in another comune.

name: Filippo Arena, b. 9 May 1857
note: Tavola annuale, container Lpp8OGq, index at images 131-138. The same couple as act 43 of 1860 -- so Giovanni Arena and Maddalena Longordo had Filippo in 1857 and Domenico in 1860. An adult Giovanni Arena, born in the 1830s, and NOT the Giovanni Arena this archive wants.

name: Clemente Arena, b. 16 March 1857
note: The other Arena birth of 1857. Not in the family tree.

name: GIOVANNI ARENA — SOUGHT, NOT FOUND (and the search is now closed)
note: The complete A section of the 1857 Tavola holds eight entries, of which two are Arena -- Clemente (68) and Filippo (100). No Giovanni. THAT IS FOUR CONSECUTIVE YEARS: 1857, 1858, 1859 and 1860 all read in full, all negative. Act 230 of 1892 makes Giovanni Arena thirty-three in October 1892, which puts his birth between October 1858 and October 1859, and the archive has now read two years either side of that. He was very probably NOT BORN AT SCILLA. The next move is his marriage to Concetta Russo -- a marriage act names the groom's comune of birth outright -- or the 1892 act's own margin.

name: Francesco (Antonio) Arena, b. 25 November 1819
note: TWO NEW GENERATIONS ON THE DIRECT LINE, neither of them in the family tree. Tavola annuale alfabetica de' nati in questo Comune di Scilla nell'anno 1819, container 58rKlpd, index at images 115-121; the A section holds five entries and this is the fifth. Act 228 of 1861 makes Francesco Antonio Arena FORTY-TWO on 23 December 1861 and calls him expressly FIGLIO DI FILIPPO; a birth on 25 November 1819 makes him forty-two years and one month. The fit is exact. So the line now runs FILIPPO ARENA x DOMENICA COSTA -> FRANCESCO ANTONIO ARENA (b. 25 Nov 1819, marinaro) -> ROCCO ARENA (b. 20 Dec 1861) -> ANNA ARENA (b. 1893) -> Rocco Arena (b. 1924) -> Nancy Arena -> Mia and Rocco. Note the mother's surname: COSTA, which is also the surname Rocco Arena married in Generosa Costa.

name: FRANCESCO ANTONIO ARENA x SERAFINA ARLOTTA — SOUGHT, NOT FOUND
note: Scilla MATRIMONI 1859, container LzjPNeG, Tavola at images 77-80. The marriage Tavola is laid out two rows to a marriage, groom above bride, with a column for each spouse's parents -- so one opening gives four parents per couple. The A section holds a single entry and the groom is a Messinese, not an Arena.

name: FRANCESCO ANTONIO ARENA x SERAFINA ARLOTTA — SOUGHT, NOT FOUND
note: Scilla MATRIMONI 1858, container wQYJq7q, Tavola at images 73-76. The A section again holds one entry and it is not an Arena. Their son Giuseppe was born 5 March 1860, so the marriage should fall before about June 1859, and the A sections of 1856-1859 births show them with no children before Giuseppe. Two explanations remain: they married earlier than 1858 and were childless for some years, or -- more likely -- THEY MARRIED IN SERAFINA ARLOTTA'S COMUNE rather than his. An Italian marriage is registered where it is celebrated, which is usually the bride's parish.

name: Orazio Arena, b. 4 February 1833
note: Tavola annuale, container 5B6RQPk, index at images 94-100; the A section holds six entries and this is the first. A CANDIDATE for the tree's Orazio Arena, who the tree dates to 1821 -- twelve years out. An Orazio born 1833 would be twenty-three when his first documented child arrived in September 1856, which is young but ordinary; the tree also makes his wife Giovanna Zirilli six years his senior on those dates, which is less ordinary. IT ALSO CONTRADICTS THIS ARCHIVE'S OWN LEAD: from Orazio naming two sons Domenico, naming custom suggested his father was a Domenico Arena. This act says BONAVENTURA. Either the custom inference was wrong, or this is a different Orazio and the tree's 1821 is right. The test is 1821, an_ua2002812.

name: SERAFINA ARLOTTA — SOUGHT, NOT FOUND
note: The complete A section of the 1833 Tavola holds six entries, two of them Arlotta -- Gaetano (2, di Pasquale e Pizzarello Concetta) and Giuseppantonio (3, di Giovanni e Costa Maria). No Serafina. Act 228 of 1861 makes her twenty-eight, so 1833 is the year her age points to. TOGETHER WITH THE MISSING MARRIAGE in 1858 and 1859, this supports the reading that SERAFINA ARLOTTA WAS NOT OF SCILLA: her marriage would then be registered in her own comune, and so would her birth.

name: Orazio Arena, b. 14 December 1821
note: Tavola annuale, container 04rZVeY, index at images 94-99. The A section holds ten entries, three of them Arena: Giuseppe (5, di Franc.co e Bombara Maria), Giovanni (7) and ORAZIO (10). THE YEAR MATCHES THE FAMILY TREE EXACTLY -- the tree dates Orazio Arena to 1821 and gives no source. The better of the two candidates: the other, act 1 of 1833, is twelve years adrift. The mother's surname is read from one index line and is not certain; it looks like Migliara. THIS ACT RETRACTS ONE OF THIS ARCHIVE'S OWN INFERENCES -- see the note.

name: Domenico Arena, b. 24 March 1853 — SUPERSEDED: she is DOMENICA
note: Tavola annuale, container wl1lxNm, index at images 127-135; the A section holds seven entries. A THIRD CHILD of Rocco Arena's parents, and it moves their marriage back by at least six years: they were married by 1853, not 1859, which is why the 1858 and 1859 marriage indexes do not hold them. Their known children are now Domenico (1853), Giuseppe (1860) and Rocco (1861) -- with a gap from 1854 to 1859 in which the A sections of 1854, 1855, 1856, 1857, 1858 and 1859 have all been read and hold no child of theirs. The gap is recorded, not explained. SUPERSEDED 20 SEPTEMBER BY THE ACT ITSELF. This row was read off the TAVOLA and both of its key facts were wrong. THE NUMBER: «2» is the second entry in the A block, not an act number; the act is 53. THE SEX: the act says «una FEMINA» and «di dare alla FANCIULLA il nome di DOMENICA», and the baptism column names DOMENICA ARENA. SHE IS ROCCO ARENA'S SISTER, NOT HIS BROTHER. See the 1853 atto 53 row. Left standing, downgraded to «index only», because a superseded reading is part of the record and because it is the clearest illustration this archive has of why an index is not a source.

name: Teresa Arena, b. 17 October 1853
note: ORAZIO ARENA'S EARLIEST KNOWN CHILD, three years before the Domenico of 1856 -- which confirms that Domenico was NOT his first child and vindicates this archive's retraction of its own naming-custom argument. It also does better than that: Calabrian custom gives the FIRST DAUGHTER her PATERNAL GRANDMOTHER's name, and act 10 of 1821 -- the Orazio Arena whose year matches the family tree exactly -- gives his mother as TERESA. Orazio's first daughter is Teresa. That is independent corroboration that act 10 of 1821 is the right man.

name: Giovanni Arena, b. 30 April 1854
note: THE ACT, AT LAST, AND IT SETTLES THE LAST OPEN ARENA QUESTION. The 1854 Tavola carries NO act numbers, so this act was reached by calibrating dates against act numbers: in this volume there are TWO acts to an opening and act = 66 + 2*(image-36), which put the last days of April at images 39-41. ATTO 76: 30 April 1854, nine o'clock at night, before the sindaco Francesco Palmisano. The declarant is GIOVANNI ARLOTTA, FIGLIO DEL FU DOMENICO, DI ANNI SETTANTACINQUE, MARINARO -- the child's MATERNAL GRANDFATHER, who presents the boy himself and gives him HIS OWN NAME. The child was born at nine that morning in the house of the spouses, to SERAFINA ARLOTTA, of twenty-two, and to ANTONIO ARENA, of THIRTY-FOUR, MARINARO. Witnesses D. Rocco Ila, civile, and Pietro Morabito, scrivente. THE TAVOLA WAS WRONG AND THIS ARCHIVE REPEATED IT. The index entry read 'Arena Giovanni di Antonio e Arlotta ROSA, 20 April', and on that reading this archive wrote that the boy's mother was a ROSA Arlotta and therefore probably Serafina's sister, which made him Rocco's COUSIN and not his brother. The act says SERAFINA, and it says the THIRTIETH of April. AND THE AGES CLOSE IT. Francesco Antonio Arena was born 25 November 1819, so he is THIRTY-FOUR in April 1854 -- exact. Serafina Arlotta was born 13 June 1830, so she is twenty-three and ten months, entered as twenty-two. Both are marinari. 'Antonio Arena' is FRANCESCO Antonio with the first name dropped, exactly as the 1853 and 1861 acts have him. So GIOVANNI ARENA IS ROCCO ARENA'S FULL BROTHER, and the 1899 manifest in which a Giovanni Arena sails to join 'brother Rocco' is documented at both ends.

name: NO ARENA OF FRANCESCO ANTONIO OR ORAZIO
note: Container LqAr1OG, index at images 123-129. The A section holds five entries and one Arena -- Teresa, di Raffaele. Neither couple appears.

name: Filippo Arena, b. 14 February 1852
note: 1852 is a doubled year of the usual kind: an_ua2002904 (container wX9avAO, 104 images) holds the acts with no index, an_ua2002907 (container LNolBvO, 40 images) carries the Tavola at images 33-40. The A section holds five entries and this is the first. THE NAMING CUSTOM LANDS EXACTLY: act 186 of 1819 gives Francesco Antonio Arena's father as FILIPPO, and here is Francesco Antonio's FIRST SON, named FILIPPO. That is a third independent line of support for the Filippo Arena generation. CAVEAT: the index writes the father as 'Ant.o', not 'Francesc'Antonio' as 1853 does, so the identification rests on the surname plus the wife's distinctive name -- Arlotta Serafina -- rather than on the father's forename. It also moves the marriage to 1851 or earlier. Their children are now Filippo (1852), Domenico (1853), Giuseppe (1860) and Rocco (1861).

name: NO CHILD OF ORAZIO ARENA
note: The complete A section of the 1852 Tavola: Arena Filippo (1), Arbitrio Giuseppe (2), Alfonzetti Maria (3), Arlotta Antonia (4), Arbitrio Pietro (5). No child of Orazio Arena and Giovanna Zirilli, whose earliest known child is therefore Teresa in October 1853.

name: Francesco Arena (31, marinaro) x Serafina Arlotta (20) — promise 7 February, celebrated 16 February 1851
father: HIS: Filippo Arena, marinaro, and Domenica Costa
mother: HERS: Giovanni Arlotta, marinaro, and Maria Costa
note: Scilla MATRIMONI 1851, container LD6brxB, image 15, Num. d'Ordine 13, foglio 13. Before Gaetano Ferrante, sindaco. FOUR PARENTS IN ONE ACT, exactly as the marriage Tavola promises. 'Francesco Arena di anni TRENTUNO, nato in questo Comune, di professione MARINARO, figlio di FILIPPO, di professione STESSA, e di DOMENICA COSTA... E SERAFINA ARLOTTA di anni VENTI, nata in questo Comune, figlia di GIOVANNI, di professione MARINARO, e di MARIA COSTA.' Thirty-one on 7 February 1851 means born about 1819-20, and act 186 of 1819 gives 25 November 1819 -- EXACT. It CONFIRMS Filippo Arena and Domenica Costa from a second independent document, ADDS Filippo's trade (marinaro, 'professione stessa'), and ADDS TWO ENTIRELY NEW PEOPLE: GIOVANNI ARLOTTA, marinaro, and MARIA COSTA. Serafina's age of twenty gives a birth about 1830-31 where act 228 of 1861 makes her 28, so about 1833 -- a two-year spread, ordinary for ages. HOW IT WAS FOUND, AND THE MISTAKE ON THE WAY: the Tavola's number column was first read as 19 and 20; acts 19 and 20 turned out to be other couples. The numbers are 13 and 6. The archive had misread its own digits, not found a second series.

name: FILIPPO ARENA x DOMENICA COSTA — SOUGHT, NOT FOUND
note: Scilla MATRIMONI 1818, container LPaGar8, Tavola at images 41-43. CAUTION THAT COST A PAGE: THIS YEAR'S TAVOLA IS ALPHABETISED BY THE GROOM'S GIVEN NAME, not his surname -- the A section is Antonio, Antonino; the C is Cosimo; the D is Domenico and Diego. So Filippo Arena would sit under F. The F section holds Francesco Migliarino, Francesco Polimeni, FILIPPO PIZZARELLO and Francesco La Valle. No Filippo Arena.

name: FILIPPO ARENA x DOMENICA COSTA — SOUGHT, NOT FOUND
note: Scilla MATRIMONI 1819, container 0AJEJ8b, Tavola at images 75-79. THIS YEAR IS ALPHABETISED BY SURNAME -- the convention changes from one year to the next, which is a trap worth knowing. The A section holds exactly ONE entry, Arlotta Grazio x Papalia Giovanna on 8 February. No Arena. WHAT THIS DEDUCES: Francesco Arena was born 25 November 1819, so a marriage as late as February 1819 could still have produced him -- and neither 1818 nor 1819 holds it. THE MARRIAGE IS THEREFORE 1817 OR EARLIER, WHICH MEANS FRANCESCO WAS NOT THEIR FIRST CHILD. There should be elder Arena children of Filippo and Domenica Costa in the birth registers of 1816, 1817 and 1818 -- arks an_ua2002801, an_ua2002803 and an_ua2002805, all in data/scilla-arks.tsv.

name: Serafina Arlotta, b. 13 June 1830
note: Tavola annuale, container LaNd12r, index at images 119-125; the A section holds four entries and this is the second. ROCCO ARENA'S MOTHER, WITH AN EXACT BIRTH DATE AT LAST, AND HER PARENTS CONFIRMED FROM A SECOND INDEPENDENT DOCUMENT. Act 13 of 1851 makes her TWENTY on 7 February 1851 and names her parents Giovanni Arlotta and Maria Costa; a birth on 13 June 1830 makes her twenty years and seven months. Exact, and the parents match to the letter. It also retires the earlier reading of her age: act 228 of 1861 makes her 28, which would give 1833 -- she was in fact 31. THE SAME A SECTION also carries Arena Errico, di Bonaventura e TERRANOVA Marianna (act 1, 10 May), where act 1 of 1833 gave an Orazio Arena di Bonaventura e ROMANO Marianna. Same father, same wife's given name, two different surnames for her -- one of the two indexes misreads her, and neither man is in this line.

name: GIOVANNI ARLOTTA x MARIA COSTA — SOUGHT, NOT FOUND
note: Scilla MATRIMONI 1829, container LoyEenm, Tavola at images 36-38. Alphabetised by SURNAME, and the table OPENS AT B -- Battaglia, Bellantoni, Bueti, Barbera, Briganti, Brinda, Bova -- with no A section at all. So there was no Arlotta groom in 1829. Serafina was born 13 June 1830, so the marriage can be 1829 or earlier; 1829 is now excluded, and if she was not their first child it may be years earlier still.

name: FRANCESCO ARENA'S ELDER SIBLINGS — THE READ IS BIGGER THAN IT LOOKED
note: Scilla NATI 1818, container wWA7mYX, Tavola at images 104-110. THE SAME TRAP AS THE 1818 MARRIAGES, IN THE BIRTH REGISTER: this year's Tavola is alphabetised by the CHILD'S GIVEN NAME -- the A section is Antonia, Antonino, Antonio, Anna, Angela, with the surname second -- so an Arena child sits under whatever first name he was given and CANNOT be found by turning to A. Locating Filippo Arena's elder children in 1816-1818 therefore means reading all seven index openings of each year, not one section. It is still bounded work, and it is four times the size this archive assumed when it set the target.

name: GIOVANNI ARLOTTA, and his father DOMENICO
note: The same act reaches a generation no record in this archive had touched. Giovanni Arlotta -- Serafina's father, Rocco Arena's maternal grandfather -- appears here in person, and the act gives him as 'FIGLIO DEL FU DOMENICO', DI ANNI SETTANTACINQUE, MARINARO. That dates him to about 1779 and names DOMENICO ARLOTTA, dead before April 1854: a GREAT-GREAT-GREAT-GREAT-GREAT-GRANDFATHER of Mia and Rocco, and the deepest the Calabrian side has ever reached. It also adds a fourth generation of sailors on that side: Domenico's son Giovanni marinaro, his son-in-law Francesco Antonio marinaro, his grandson Rocco marinaro.

name: GIOVANNI ARENA x CONCETTA RUSSO — 29 October 1885
note: THE ACT THIS ARCHIVE SAID WAS NOT ON ANTENATI. It is, and so is every other Scilla civil marriage from 1866 to 1913 -- see the coverage note. 29 OCTOBER 1885, ten fifty-three in the morning, in the Casa Comunale of Scilla, before D'Amico Gaetano, assessore. 1o ARENA GIOVANNI, DI ANNI TRENTUNO, MARINARO, nato in questo Comune, FIGLIO DI ANTONIO e di SERAFINA ARLOTTA, both living at Scilla. 2o RUSSO CONCETTA, DI ANNI VENTISEI, FILATRICE, nata in questo Comune, FIGLIA DI LEONARDO e di ANGELA BAGNATO, both living at Scilla. Witnesses Cardona Antonio, 30, civile, and Minasi Francesco, 31, proprietario. The bride could not sign: 'meno della sposa perche illetterata'. WHAT IT DOES. It makes Giovanni Arena a son of Francesco Antonio Arena and Serafina Arlotta -- ROCCO'S BROTHER -- and it dates him: thirty-one in October 1885 is a birth about 1854, which is the Giovanni Arena of ACT 76 OF 1854, born 30 April. AND IT COLLAPSES THREE MEN INTO ONE. This archive had kept apart (a) the Giovanni Arena born 1854, (b) the Giovanni Arena who married Concetta Russo, and (c) the Giovanni Arena of act 230 of 1892, a pescatore entered as thirty-three, whose birth could not be found in 1857-1860. They are ONE MAN. He was born in 1854, which is why four years of searching 1857-1860 found nothing; the 1892 act's 'thirty-three' is three years out, like so many declared ages here. And he is the Giovanni Arena of the 1899 manifest who sails to join 'brother Rocco'.

name: GIUSEPPE ARENA x MARIA MARTELLO — 12 September 1885
note: Seven weeks before his brother. 12 SEPTEMBER 1885, ten thirty-seven in the morning. 1o ARENA GIUSEPPE, DI ANNI VENTICINQUE, MARINARO, nato in Scilla, FIGLIO DI FRANCESCO ANTONIO e di SERAFINA ARLOTTA. 2o MARTELLO MARIA, DI ANNI VENTIQUATTRO, FILATRICE, nata in Scilla, FIGLIA DI PAOLO, RESIDENTE IN AMERICA, e di GIOVANNA CHIRICO, residente in questo Comune. Witnesses Bellantoni Domenico, 45, civile, and Ciccone Candeloro, 45, guardia. Both spouses illiterate. TWO THINGS. The father is written out IN FULL here -- FRANCESCO ANTONIO -- which proves that the 'Antonio Arena' of the 1854 and 1885 acts is the same man. And Giuseppe at twenty-five in September 1885 is the Giuseppe born 5 MARCH 1860, act 45, exactly. The bride's father PAOLO MARTELLO was ALREADY IN AMERICA IN 1885, seven years before Rocco Arena first sailed. Scilla was going before this family went.

name: ARENA FILIPPO x FURFARI CLEMENTINA — NOT THIS FAMILY
note: Worth recording because it is the kind of thing that would otherwise be assumed. 19 November 1885: ARENA FILIPPO, di anni VENTOTTO, PESCATORE, nato in Scilla, FIGLIO DEL FU GIOVANNI e di NATALIZIA LONGORDO; FURFARI CLEMENTINA, di anni DICIOTTO, filatrice, figlia di ROCCO e di DOMENICA RUSSO. Rocco Arena's eldest brother was also a Filippo, born 1852, and this man is the right age -- but his parents are a different couple altogether. NOT ROCCO'S BROTHER. There were at least four Arena households at Scilla in 1885.

name: ROCCO ARENA x GENEROSA COSTA — SOUGHT IN NINE YEARS, NOT FOUND
note: The 1900 census of Manhattan records Rocco Arena and Generosa Costa as MARRIED TEN YEARS, so about 1890. The annual indexes of the Scilla civil marriages have now been read for 1885, 1886, 1887, 1889, 1890, 1891, 1892, 1893 and 1894, and THERE IS NO ROCCO ARENA MARRYING A COSTA IN ANY OF THEM. There is an ARENA ROCCO MARIA who marries LICO M. CONCETTA at act 12 of 1891 -- a different man, and a warning. ONE YEAR CANNOT BE EXCLUDED. The 1888 volume carries the archivist's own slip: VOLUME DANNEGGIATO DALL'UMIDITA / VOLUME LACERO / IMPOSSIBILE FARE MEGLIO, and the damage falls on the top-left of the index -- exactly where the A entries are. 1888 is therefore the open year, and it fits the census within two years. The alternative is that they married in Generosa Costa's comune and not in his.

name: SCILLA CIVIL REGISTRATION — THE COVERAGE NOTE WAS WRONG
note: This archive had recorded that Scilla's marriages on Antenati were 'restaurazione to 1865, then 1905-1913'. That is wrong, and it had blocked at least three searches. The Stato civile italiano series for Scilla holds MATRIMONI 1866 TO 1913 -- FORTY-EIGHT VOLUMES, unbroken -- and alongside them 46 volumes of MATRIMONI, PUBBLICAZIONI (the banns, which name the parents and often the grandparents), 81 volumes of MORTI, and 51 of CITTADINANZE. Every volume ends with an INDICE ANNUALE listing both spouses against the act number. Ark for year Y is not computable -- the list is in data/scilla-arks-italiano.tsv.

name: ROCCO ARENA x GENEROSA COSTA — DECEMBER 1888
note: THE ACT THIS ARCHIVE HAS WANTED FROM THE BEGINNING, AND THE MOST DIRECT PROOF IT WILL EVER HAVE. Scilla, Casa Comunale, DECEMBER 1888, at ten in the morning, before MINASI FRANCESCO, sindaco. 1o ARENA ROCCO, MARINARO, nato in Scilla, residente in Scilla, FIGLIO DI FRANCESCO ANTONIO, residente in Scilla, E DI SERAFINA ARLOTTA, residente in Scilla. 2o COSTA GENEROSA, FILATRICE, nata in Scilla, residente in Scilla, FIGLIA DI ANTONIO, residente in Scilla, E DI ANNA ARLOTTA, residente in Scilla. The day of the month and both ages are lost under an ink blot; the month and the year are not. WHAT IT SETTLES. This archive corrected Rocco Arena's parentage from ORAZIO ARENA to FRANCESCO ANTONIO ARENA and SERAFINA ARLOTTA on five circumstantial supports -- a sibling pair, a naming custom, an Arlotta lodger in New York, a daughter called Serafina, and the marriage act of 1851. HERE IS ROCCO'S OWN MARRIAGE ACT SAYING IT OUTRIGHT. Nothing stronger exists. AND IT NAMES GENEROSA'S PARENTS FOR THE FIRST TIME: ANTONIO COSTA and ANNA ARLOTTA. NOTE THE MOTHER'S SURNAME. Rocco's mother is an ARLOTTA and his wife's mother is an ARLOTTA. The two families are tied twice over, which is very likely why a ROCCO ARLOTTA was lodging with them in Manhattan in 1900, and it raises the real possibility that Rocco and Generosa were cousins. AND IT CORRECTS THE CENSUS. The 1900 census of Manhattan records them as MARRIED TEN YEARS, which this archive read as 1890. The act says DECEMBER 1888 -- eighteen months earlier, and twelve years, not ten.

name: HOW THE ACT WAS FOUND, WHEN THE INDEX WAS DESTROYED
note: Worth writing down, because the same trick will work elsewhere. The annual index of the Scilla marriages of 1888 is ruined: the volume carries the archivist's own slip -- VOLUME DANNEGGIATO DALL'UMIDITA / VOLUME LACERO / IMPOSSIBILE FARE MEGLIO -- and the water damage falls on the top-left of the index, exactly where the A entries are. Nine other years were read and the couple was in none of them. TWO STEPS GOT ROUND IT. FIRST, THE BANNS. Antenati holds a SEPARATE SERIES of 46 volumes of MATRIMONI, PUBBLICAZIONI, each with its OWN annual index -- and the 1888 banns index survives where the marriage index does not. Under A it reads, in a clear hand, ARENA ROCCO / COSTA GENEROSA. The registro number beside it is under the stain, but the YEAR was now certain. SECOND, THE MARGINS. Every act page of these registers carries a boxed margin with the act number and both spouses' names. tools/margin_names.py cuts just those boxes and montages them, so the whole volume -- forty-five openings, sixty-six acts -- can be scanned for one couple in FOUR IMAGES. Act 63 turned up on image 33. THE RULE: A DAMAGED INDEX IS NOT A DEAD END. There is nearly always a second index of the same events, and failing that the acts themselves index in the margin.

name: MICHELE DONATO'S MARRIAGE — SOUGHT IN THE NEWLY-OPENED SERIES, NOT FOUND
note: The first search made possible by correcting the coverage note. Michele Donato's eldest son was born in 1878, so his marriage should be about 1875-77, and a marriage act names the groom's COMUNE OF BIRTH outright -- the one fact three complete sweeps of the Scilla birth registers have failed to find. THE ANNUAL INDEXES OF 1874, 1876, 1877 AND 1878 HAVE NOW BEEN READ, and there is NO DONATO MICHELE among the grooms. 1875 HAS NO INDEX AT ALL; its acts 3 to 26 were scanned by the margin boxes and hold no Donato groom either. WHAT IS THERE INSTEAD, AND IT MATTERS: DONATO CANDELORO marries Romano Domenica at act 62 of 1874 and Bova Anna Maria at act 43 of 1877; DONATO BRUNO marries Milano Concetta Caterina at act 22 of 1878; and a DONATO CARMELA marries Tedesco Mariano at act 26 of 1875. SO THE DONATO WERE AT SCILLA IN THE 1870s, marrying and being married. This archive had wondered whether the surname ARRIVED at Scilla between 1859 and 1892; it did not -- it was there all along. Which sharpens the question rather than answering it: the Donato are a Scilla family, and MICHELE is still not born there and now not married there either. NEXT: the rest of 1875 by margin scan, then 1879 onward; and the MORTI, since a death act names parents and a birthplace.

name: SCILLA DEATHS: EIGHTY-ONE VOLUMES, 1866 TO 1943
note: The second series the corrected coverage note opened, and the larger of the two. Antenati holds EIGHTY-ONE volumes of Scilla MORTI, 1866 to 1943 -- seventy-seven years without a real gap. Every volume ends with an INDICE ANNUALE, and the death indexes are BETTER THAN THE MARRIAGE ONES: each line gives the name, a PATRONYMIC in the Italian form -- 'di X' where the father is living, 'fu X' where he is dead -- and the act number. So a single index opening tells you not only who died but whose child they were and whether that parent was still alive. Arks are in data/scilla-arks-italiano.tsv. A death act of this period names the deceased's age, trade, birthplace, parents and spouse -- which is why this series is the fastest route left to Michele Donato's comune of birth, and to the deaths of Francesco Antonio Arena, Serafina Arlotta and Giovanni Arlotta.

name: THE ARENA AND ARLOTTA DEATHS, 1889-1893 — FIVE YEARS READ
note: The A block of the annual death index has been read for 1889, 1890, 1891, 1892 and 1893. NEITHER FRANCESCO ANTONIO ARENA NOR SERAFINA ARLOTTA IS IN ANY OF THEM -- and both were alive and living at Scilla in December 1888, when their son Rocco's marriage act names them. So they died after 1893, or under a form of the name the index does not carry. WHAT THE FIVE YEARS DO HOLD, and it is a great deal: 1889 -- Arena Orazio di Alessandro (48), Arlotta Giuseppe fu Filippo (152), Arlotta Grazia di Rocco (159). 1890 -- Arlotta Santo fu Antonio (118), Arena Giovanna di Alessandro (144). 1891 -- Arlotta Grazia fu Antonio (2 s.p.), Arena Natalina di Filippo (33), Arena Santo d'Annunziato (36), Arlotta Giuseppe fu Antonio (57), Arena M. Giuseppa fu Santo (58), ARENA FORTUNATO DI GIOVANNI (134). 1892 -- no Arena. 1893 -- ARENA RAFFAELA FU ANTONIO (5), Arlotta Giuseppa di Filippo (34), Arlotta Gaetano fu Grazio (149). TWO OF THOSE ARE LEADS, NOT FINDINGS. 'ARENA FORTUNATO DI GIOVANNI', act 134 of 1891, is a child of a LIVING Giovanni Arena -- and Giovanni Arena, Rocco's brother, married Concetta Russo in October 1885, so a child dying in 1891 fits exactly. If it is theirs, it is a child the family tree does not have. 'ARENA RAFFAELA FU ANTONIO', act 5 of 1893, is a daughter of a DEAD Antonio Arena -- and Francesco Antonio is called ANTONIO in three acts. If that is him, he died between December 1888 and early 1893, which the same indexes say he did not. There were at least four Arena households at Scilla; neither reading is safe without the act.

name: GIOVANNI POLISTENA x NUNZIATA DONATO — OUT OF RANGE, NOT UNSEARCHED
note: Worth stating plainly so it stops being listed as a target. The Scilla civil MARRIAGE series ends at 1913. This archive dates Giovanni Polistena's return from America and his marriage to Nunziata Donato to ABOUT 1916, and 1913 has already been read and does not hold them. So the act is NOT on Antenati at all: it is inside the closed period and belongs to the comune. It goes on the same request as Nunziata's death act of 1975. THE MORTI, HOWEVER, RUN TO 1943 -- so their deaths, and Michele Donato's, are reachable where their marriage is not.

name: FORTUNATO ARENA — A CHILD OF GIOVANNI AND CONCETTA, DEAD AT TEN DAYS
note: The lead from the death index, opened, and it holds. SCILLA, MORTI 1891, ATTO 134. On 1 OCTOBER 1891 at five past nine in the morning, before D'Amico Gaetano, assessore, two becchini -- IGNAZIO FONTANA, 48, and ANTONIO CAROLEO, 38 -- declared that at half past three that morning, IN THE HOUSE AT VIA GROTTE NUMBER SEVENTY, there had died ARENA FORTUNATO, DI GIORNI DIECI -- TEN DAYS OLD -- born in this comune of GIOVANNI, PESCATORE, and of CONCETTA RUSSO, FILATRICE, both of Scilla. Witnesses Perina Giuseppe, 57, pescatore, and ARLOTTA GIUSEPPE, 55, pescatore. SO THE BOY WAS BORN ABOUT 21 SEPTEMBER 1891 AND LIVED TEN DAYS. He is a son of ROCCO ARENA'S BROTHER, and the family tree does not have him. IT ALSO FIXES THE HOUSEHOLD. Giovanni is a PESCATORE here, exactly as his son Giuseppe's birth act of 1892 says, and the address is VIA GROTTE -- the same street, thirteen months later, where Giuseppe is born at number 75. And an ARLOTTA stands witness, as an Arlotta lodges with Rocco in New York and an Arlotta declared Giovanni's own birth in 1854.

name: ARENA RAFFAELA FU ANTONIO — A DIFFERENT FAMILY. LEAD CLOSED
note: The other lead from the death index, opened, and it does NOT hold -- which is worth as much. SCILLA, MORTI 1893, ATTO 5, 6 January 1893: in the house at VIA ACQUAGRANDE number sixty died ARENA RAFFAELA, DI ANNI SESSANTUNO, FILATRICE, born in this comune of THE LATE ANTONIO, PESCATORE, and of THE LATE TERESA PONTILLO, FILATRICE; VEDOVA DI PERINA ROCCO. So the 'fu Antonio' is ANTONIO ARENA x TERESA PONTILLO, a household this archive had never met, and NOT Francesco Antonio Arena, whose wife is Serafina Arlotta. FRANCESCO ANTONIO'S DEATH IS STILL NOT FOUND. TWO THINGS TO KEEP. The surname PONTILLO is a real Scilla surname, which bears on the archive's Romano-versus-Pontillo question. And VIA ACQUAGRANDE is where Rocco Arena's daughter Anna was born in 1893, at number 41 -- the Arena were spread along two streets, Via Grotte and Via Acquagrande.

name: FRANCESCO ANTONIO ARENA AND SERAFINA ARLOTTA — EIGHT YEARS OF DEATHS, NEITHER OF THEM
note: The A block of the Scilla annual death index has now been read for 1889, 1890, 1891, 1892, 1893, 1894, 1895 and 1896. NEITHER FRANCESCO ANTONIO ARENA NOR SERAFINA ARLOTTA IS IN ANY OF THEM. Both were alive and living at Scilla in DECEMBER 1888, when their son Rocco's marriage act names them, and he would have been sixty-nine and she fifty-eight. So they died in 1897 or later, and the series runs to 1943. What those eight years do hold is a crowd of other Arena and Arlotta -- Arena Orazio FU ANTONIO (1895, act 133), Arena Domenica di Santo (1895, 140), Arena Eugenia fu Carlo (1896, 48), Arena Rosa di Giuseppe (1896, 17), Arlotta Domenico di Giovanni (1895, 2), Arlotta Teresa fu Vincenzo (1895, 32) -- which is the clearest measure yet of how many separate Arena and Arlotta households Scilla held.

name: THE HIGH NUMBERS OF A SCILLA MARRIAGE VOLUME ARE TRANSCRIPTIONS FROM ABROAD
note: Sought: act 103 of 1885, ARENA ANNUNZIATO x MATRA MARIANTONIA, the one Arena wedding of that year this archive had not opened. What image 53 holds instead is a PARTE II section -- marriages celebrated ABROAD and transcribed at Scilla, complete with the certificate of a CASA CONSOLARE, the countersignature of the MINISTERO DEGLI AFFARI ESTERI, and banns published on two Sundays in one country and two more in another. THAT IS A FINDING IN ITSELF. By 1885 Scilla was registering marriages made overseas, seven years before Rocco Arena first sailed and the same year Maria Martello's father was already 'residente in America'. The high act numbers in these volumes are not ordinary weddings and should not be read as such.

name: ARENA ORAZIO — AND HE IS NOT THE ORAZIO THE FAMILY TREE MEANS
note: The last loose thread in the parentage story, pulled. The family tree gives Rocco Arena's father as an ORAZIO ARENA married to GIOVANNA ZIRILLI. Here is an Orazio Arena dying at Scilla, and the act is unambiguous. SCILLA, MORTI 1895, ATTO 133: 31 AUGUST 1895, ten thirty in the morning, in the house at VIA ACQUAGRANDE number seventy, died ARENA ORAZIO, DI ANNI SESSANTACINQUE, PESCATORE, born in this comune of THE LATE ANTONIO, PROPRIETARIO, and of THE LATE SERAFINA DELUCA, FILATRICE; MARITO DI CONCETTA MARIA NESTRO. Declared by two becchini, Sgarlata Giovanni 56 and Tesoriere Domenico 39; witnesses Perina Raffaele 65, pescatore, and SOFI MICHELANGELO 62, pescatore. SO HE IS A THIRD HOUSEHOLD. His wife is not Giovanna Zirilli; his father is an Antonio Arena, proprietario, not the Filippo Arena of this family. Born about 1830 he is the right generation to be confused with Francesco Antonio, and that is very likely how the confusion began. AND A CAUTION WORTH MORE THAN THE ACT: HIS MOTHER IS A SERAFINA TOO. Serafina DELUCA, not Serafina Arlotta. Between this act, act 2 of the same year and the family this archive is following, there are THREE SERAFINAS in one small circle of Scilla. A given name is not an identification.

name: ARLOTTA DOMENICO, NINE MONTHS OLD, AT VIA GROTTE 60
note: The other death-index lead. SCILLA, MORTI 1895, ATTO 2: 2 JANUARY 1895, half past two in the morning, in the house at VIA GROTTE number SESSANTA, died ARLOTTA DOMENICO, DI MESI NOVE, born in this comune of GIOVANNI, MARINARO, and of SERAFINA BELLANTONI, FILATRICE. Witnesses Romano Francesco, 60, marinaro, and Sofi Nunzio, 53, pescatore. NOT OUR GIOVANNI ARLOTTA -- ours was born about 1779 and would be a hundred and sixteen. But the address is the finding. VIA GROTTE 60 is one door from VIA GROTTE 70, where Giovanni Arena and Concetta Russo lost their ten-day-old Fortunato four years earlier, and a few from VIA GROTTE 75, where their Giuseppe was born in 1892. THE ARENA AND THE ARLOTTA WERE NEIGHBOURS IN THE SAME LANE, which is the plainest explanation yet for why an Arlotta witnesses their acts, an Arlotta declared Giovanni Arena's birth in 1854, and an Arlotta lodged with Rocco Arena in Manhattan in 1900. The witnesses carry two more surnames this archive is chasing: ROMANO and SOFI.

name: THE BANNS OF ROCCO AND GENEROSA — AND A SWORN ANSWER TO THE COUSIN QUESTION
note: SCILLA, PUBBLICAZIONI DI MATRIMONIO 1888, NUMERO 63. On 18 NOVEMBER 1888 at nine thirty-six in the morning, before MINASI LUIGI, assessore, ARENA ROCCO -- MARINARO, of Scilla -- came to ask for the banns. The first publication was posted on the door of the Casa Comunale that Sunday, 18 November, the second on the 25th; the marriage followed in December, act 63 of the marriages. WHAT THE BANNS ADD THAT THE MARRIAGE ACT DOES NOT. FRANCESCO ANTONIO ARENA APPEARS IN PERSON, ALIVE, RESIDENT AT SCILLA, A PESCATORE, AND AGED -- the ink is faded but the word reads SESSANTOTTO, sixty-eight. He was born 25 NOVEMBER 1819, so on 18 November 1888 he was sixty-eight and a week short of sixty-nine. EXACT. It is the last confirmed sighting of him alive, and the death indexes of 1889 to 1896 do not hold him. SERAFINA ARLOTTA is given as FILATRICE and resident -- a trade for her for the first time, and alive too. GENEROSA COSTA is TWENTY and a FILATRICE, so born about 1868. Her father ANTONIO COSTA is FORTY-EIGHT and a PESCATORE, so born about 1840. Her mother ANNA ARLOTTA is also a filatrice. Witnesses: Musco Emanuele, 48, civile, and Panebianco Filippo, 54, PITTORE. AND THE PART THAT SETTLES SOMETHING. The couple swore, in the legal form, that there was NON OSTARE AL LORO MATRIMONIO ALCUN IMPEDIMENTO DI PARENTELA O DI AFFINITA -- no impediment of kinship or affinity. Under the law of the time FIRST COUSINS required a dispensation and would have been exactly such an impediment. So ROCCO ARENA AND GENEROSA COSTA WERE NOT FIRST COUSINS, whatever the two Arlotta mothers were to each other. The question this archive raised when it found Anna Arlotta is answered, and answered in the negative.

name: DONATO MARIA — MICHELE AND MARIA SOFI'S DAUGHTER, DEAD AT TWENTY-EIGHT MONTHS
note: Found in the D block of the annual death index -- 'Donato MARIA DI MICHELE, 22' -- and the act holds. SCILLA, MORTI 1891, ATTO 22: 17 FEBRUARY 1891 at a quarter past nine in the morning, two becchini -- MARCELLO CAROLEO, 71, and ROCCO FURFARI, 61 -- declared that at half past four the previous afternoon, IN THE HOUSE AT VIA GROTTE NUMBER VENTUNO, had died DONATO MARIA, DI MESI VENTOTTO -- twenty-eight months old -- born in this comune of MICHELE, PESCATORE, and of MARIA SOFI, FILATRICE, both of Scilla. Witnesses Nostro Ferdinando, 53, pescatore, and Perina Giuseppe, 57, pescatore. SO: MARIA DONATO, born about OCTOBER 1888, died 16 FEBRUARY 1891. A DAUGHTER THE FAMILY TREE DOES NOT HAVE, and a sister of Nunziata Donato. IT ALSO GIVES MICHELE DONATO A TRADE -- PESCATORE -- puts the household at VIA GROTTE 21, and shows him ALIVE IN FEBRUARY 1891, which is consistent with act 162 of July 1892 where he is thirty-six.

name: THE VIA GROTTE HOUSEHOLDS
note: Five acts now place five families in one short lane, and the pattern is worth setting down. VIA GROTTE 21: Michele Donato and Maria Sofi, whose daughter Maria died there in 1891. VIA GROTTE 60: a Giovanni Arlotta and Serafina Bellantoni, whose nine-month-old Domenico died there in 1895. VIA GROTTE 70: Giovanni Arena and Concetta Russo, whose ten-day-old Fortunato died there in 1891 -- AND, six weeks earlier, an Antonino Nostro and Domenica Calabrese, whose year-old Antonio died at the SAME NUMBER, so seventy was a tenement and not a house. VIA GROTTE 75: the same Giovanni Arena and Concetta Russo, where their Giuseppe was born in October 1892. AND THE SAME MEN KEEP SIGNING. ARLOTTA GIUSEPPE, 55, pescatore, and SOFI MICHELANGELO, 56, pescatore, witness both Via Grotte 70 deaths of 1891. PERINA GIUSEPPE, 57, pescatore, witnesses the Arena child and the Donato child. These are neighbours doing for each other what neighbours do, and it explains a great deal -- why an Arlotta declared Giovanni Arena's birth in 1854, why an Arlotta lodged with Rocco Arena in Manhattan in 1900, and why the Donato and the Sofi married.

name: FRANCESCO ANTONIO ARENA AND SERAFINA ARLOTTA — TWELVE YEARS OF DEATHS, AND ONE LOOSE END
note: The A block of the Scilla annual death index has now been read for 1889, 1890, 1891, 1892, 1893, 1894, 1895, 1896, 1897, 1898, 1899, 1900 and 1902. NEITHER FRANCESCO ANTONIO ARENA NOR SERAFINA ARLOTTA APPEARS IN ANY OF THEM. The banns of November 1888 put him alive at SIXTY-EIGHT and her alive and working as a filatrice. Twelve years later neither has died at Scilla. Either they died in one of the three years still unchecked -- 1901, 1903, 1904 -- or later, or they left. The series runs to 1943. ONE LOOSE END WORTH THE NEXT PERSON'S TIME. The 1898 index carries an entry reading ARENA FRANCESCO GIOVANNI with NO REGISTER NUMBER against it -- the column is blank where every other line has a figure. Our man is Francesco ANTONIO, not Francesco Giovanni, so it is probably somebody else; but an entry without a number cannot be opened from the index, and it is the only Arena Francesco in thirteen years. It would have to be found by scanning the margins of the 1898 acts.

name: FRANCESCO GIOVANNI ROCCO ARENA — TEN MONTHS OLD, AND NAMED FOR THREE MEN
note: THE LOOSE END, CLOSED -- AND BY ARITHMETIC RATHER THAN A SWEEP. The 1898 index carried a line reading 'Arena Francesco Giovanni' with the register column apparently blank. It is not blank: the name runs to THREE given names and spills onto the next line, and the number sits beside the overflow. The entries within a letter block are in ACT ORDER, so an entry between 88 and 91 could only be 89, 90 or 91 -- and one image, the twenty-fourth, holds all of them. In this volume act = 33 + 4*(image-10). SCILLA, MORTI 1898, ATTO 91: 30 JUNE 1898 at a quarter past four in the afternoon, in the house at VIA ACQUAGRANDE number TRENTA, died ARENA FRANCESCO, DI MESI DIECI COMPITI -- ten months old -- born in this comune of GIUSEPPE, PESCATORE, and of MARIA MARTELLO, FILATRICE. Declared by the becchini Sgarlato Giovanni, 54, and Tesoriere Domenico, 44; witnesses Perina Restato, 33, pescatore, and Pontillo Onofrio, 40, pescatore. GIUSEPPE ARENA AND MARIA MARTELLO ARE ROCCO'S BROTHER AND HIS WIFE, married on 12 September 1885 at act 73. So this is a NEPHEW OF ROCCO ARENA, born about AUGUST 1897 and dead at ten months, and the family tree does not have him. AND LOOK AT THE NAME. The margin gives it in full: FRANCESCO GIOVANNI ROCCO. His paternal grandfather was FRANCESCO Antonio Arena; his uncles were GIOVANNI and ROCCO. One infant carries all three. Sicilian and Calabrian naming custom has rarely spoken this plainly in this archive, and it corroborates the whole sibling group from a direction nothing else has.

name: MICHELE DONATO DID NOT MARRY AT SCILLA — NINE YEARS READ COMPLETE
note: The window is now closed at both ends. The annual indexes of the Scilla civil marriages have been read ENTIRE for 1874, 1876, 1877, 1878, 1879, 1880, 1881, 1882, 1883, 1884 and 1885 -- ELEVEN YEARS -- and 1875, which has no index at all, has been scanned down its margins for acts 3 to 26. THERE IS NO DONATO MICHELE AMONG THE GROOMS IN ANY OF IT. His eldest son was born in 1878, so the marriage cannot be later than that, and he was born about 1856, so it cannot be much earlier. WHAT THE ELEVEN YEARS DO HOLD IS A WHOLE DONATO FAMILY, marrying steadily: DONATO CANDELORO to Romano Domenica at act 62 of 1874 and to Bova Anna Maria at act 43 of 1877; DONATO CARMELA to Tedesco Mariano at act 26 of 1875; DONATO BRUNO to Milano Concetta Caterina at act 22 of 1878; DONATO ROCCO to Romano Concetta at act 31 of 1879; DONATO MICHELANGELO to Cannucci Francesca at act 14 of 1882. SO THE PICTURE IS CLEAR AND IT IS NOT THE ONE THIS ARCHIVE STARTED WITH. The Donato were a settled Scilla family through the 1870s and 1880s -- the idea that the surname ARRIVED late is dead twice over. But MICHELE is neither born there (1851, 1856 and 1859 read complete) nor married there. He came to Scilla from somewhere else and married before he came. THE ONE ROUTE LEFT IS HIS DEATH ACT, which names the birthplace outright. He was thirty-six in July 1892 and alive in February 1891; the Scilla death series runs to 1943.

name: THE MANIFEST SAID SCILLA ALL ALONG
note: The New Orleans manifest of the Liguria, 11 March 1908, is a TWO-PAGE form, and this archive had only ever read the first page. The SECOND page -- the verso, frame 764 -- carries column 29, PLACE OF BIRTH: Country and City or Town. LINE 15 IS MICHELE DONATO, and against him the clerk wrote R. CALABRIA / SCILLA. Lines 14, 16 and 17 -- Pontillo Francesco and the two Polistena -- say the same. It is not a bulk copy of the residence column: lines 9 to 11 of the same sheet say R. CALABRIA / TRESILICO, so the clerk was distinguishing between groups. That sent the search back to the Scilla birth registers, where it belonged.

name: MICHELE DONATO — BORN 3 OCTOBER 1855 AT SCILLA. THE LONGEST OPEN QUESTION IN THIS ARCHIVE, ANSWERED
note: SCILLA, NATI 1855, ATTO 163. On 4 OCTOBER 1855 at four in the afternoon, before ANTONINO DE AMICO, sindaco, there appeared DOMENICO DONATO, FIGLIO DI CANDELORO, DI ANNI TRENTOTTO, di professione MARINARO, of Scilla, who presented a male child born to NUNZIATA SOFI, DI ANNI TRENTASETTE, of Scilla, and to himself, on the THIRD DAY of that month, NELLA CASA DI PROPRIA ABITAZIONE, and gave him the name MICHELE. Witnesses Candeloro Benedetto, 31, pastaro, and Rocco Pizzarello, 32, fabbro. THE ACT REACHES THREE GENERATIONS AT ONCE: Michele, his father DOMENICO DONATO (b. c.1817, marinaro), and his grandfather CANDELORO DONATO. AND THE AGES ARE EXACT AT BOTH ENDS. Born 3 October 1855, he is THIRTY-SIX in July 1892, which is what act 162 of that year says, and FIFTY-TWO in March 1908, which is what the New Orleans manifest says. The family tree gives 1851 -- FOUR YEARS OUT. HIS MOTHER IS A SOFI. Michele Donato married MARIA SOFI; his mother was NUNZIATA SOFI. The two families were tied twice over. AND HE NAMED HIS DAUGHTER NUNZIATA -- for his own mother, exactly as Calabrian custom predicts for a first daughter. WHY IT TOOK SO LONG, AND IT WAS THIS ARCHIVE'S FAULT. The tree said 1851, so 1851 was read. His daughter's act of 1892 said thirty-six, so 1856 was read, and 1859 for good measure. THE ONE YEAR NOBODY READ WAS 1855. Three complete D sections, three negatives, and the answer sat one volume to the left the whole time.

name: NO DONATO BIRTHS AT SCILLA IN 1840
note: Read in passing while looking for the parents' marriage. The complete D section of the 1840 Tavola -- entries 42 to 53 -- holds Barbaro, Bonsano, De Lorenzo, D'Ascoli, De Franco, De Sita, De Amico, Dagno, D'Elia, De Giovanni, D'Elia and De Amico. NO DONATO. Which fits: Domenico Donato and Nunziata Sofi do not appear to be married yet in 1840.

name: DOMENICO DONATO x NUNZIATA SOFI — SIX YEARS READ, AND THE SHAPE OF THE PROBLEM
note: The act that would name CANDELORO DONATO'S WIFE and NUNZIATA SOFI'S PARENTS -- two more couples on a direct line to Mia and Rocco. Domenico was THIRTY-EIGHT and Nunziata THIRTY-SEVEN in October 1855, so the marriage is most likely 1838-1848. READ COMPLETE AND NEGATIVE: 1838, 1839, 1840, 1841, 1843 and 1847. Small years -- fourteen to twenty-six weddings, a D section of one to three lines -- so the negatives are firm. NO DOMENICO DONATO AMONG THE GROOMS. 1843 GIVES SOMETHING BETTER THAN A NEGATIVE. At act 11, DONATO ANTONIO of Scilla, figlio di BRUNO, marries ANTONIA LANZA of Catona, daughter of Antonio and Caterina Martello. A Donato whose father is BRUNO -- and a DONATO BRUNO marries at Scilla in 1878. THERE ARE AT LEAST TWO DONATO LINES IN THIS TOWN, the BRUNO line and the CANDELORO line that Michele descends from, and that is why the Donato marriages of 1874-85 are numerous while none of them is his. STILL TO READ, AND HARDER THAN THE REST: 1835-1837 and 1848-1854 are simply unread. 1842 and 1844 were opened and are BAD -- both carry the archivist's INCHIOSTRO SBIADITO and TIGHT BINDING slips, the D sections run into the gutter, and neither could be read with confidence; they need the acts themselves, by margin scan, rather than the index. AND THE 1845 AND 1846 ARKS ARE NOT WHAT THEY LOOK LIKE: they lead to NOTIFICAZIONI volumes, not the marriage acts. Scilla has two or three separate volumes a year in this series and the ark list in data/scilla-arks.tsv does not distinguish them.

name: Donato Candeloro × Bova Anna Maria
note: NOT MICHELE DONATO'S FAMILY, and worth the reading to know it. Scilla, Matrimoni 1877, atto 43, 16 September at ten forty: DONATO CANDELORO, di anni TRENTUNO, MARINARO, born and living at Scilla, «figlio del fu ANTONINO, residente in vita in Scilla, e di ANGELA DE FRANCO»; and BOVA ANNA MARIA, ventuno, FILATRICE, «figlia di MICHELANGELO e della fu GIOVANNA VITA». Witnesses Musco Vincenzo, 28, and Galli Giovanni, 30, both civile; the bride signed with a cross, «perché illetterata». THE NAME LOOKED LIKE THE ANSWER AND IS NOT: Michele Donato's father was DOMENICO Donato, figlio di Candeloro, so a Candeloro Donato marrying in 1877 looked like his elder brother by the naming custom. This Candeloro's father is ANTONINO. A second Donato household at Scilla, and a reminder that Candeloro is a recurring Donato given name there, not a fingerprint.

name: the whole annual index
note: NO DONATO AT ALL in the 1876 marriage index — read entire. Sixty-odd marriages, and the surname does not appear on either side of any of them.

name: Arena Domenico × Arena Maria
father: Giuseppe Arena / the late Orazio Arena
mother: the late Serafina Vita / Giovanna Zirilli
note: The marriage the margin of act 81 of 1870 pointed at. Groom 29, PROPRIETARIO; bride 30, donna di casa and illiterate. Orazio Arena and Serafina Vita both dead by November 1899; Giuseppe Arena and Giovanna Zirilli both living. An Arena marrying an Arena.

name: Candeloro Donato × Domenica Romano
note: MICHELE DONATO'S BROTHER. Married 11 December 1874 at twenty-seven, a MARINARO and CELIBE, to Domenica Romano, 21, filatrice. Both his parents named and BOTH ALIVE. Born about 1847, so the elder of the two known sons — and he carries his paternal grandfather's name exactly as the custom predicts, Domenico being «figlio di Candeloro» in Michele's birth act. The Candeloro Donato of 1877 is a different man, son of the late Antonino and Angela De Franco.

name: the annual index
note: THE INDEX PAGES ARE BLANK. Where 1874 and 1877 carry a filled Indice Annuale at the back, the 1875 volume's corresponding opening is an unused printed form, flagged by the archive's own card: PAGINE BIANCHE. So 1875 cannot be swept from its index; the year would have to be read act by act.

name: the Donato sweep, 1846 complete
note: THE WHOLE YEAR READ — all thirty-two acts, one to an image. NO DONATO GROOM AND NO SOFI BRIDE anywhere in it. Brides recorded so the year need never be re-read: Barbara; Maria de Lorenzo; Anna Vizzari of Solano; Maria Concetta Barbaro; Angela Martello; Santa Romano; Caterina Romano; Giuseppa Gioffrè; Giovanna Carrozza; Antonina Ardisi of Solano; Grazia Modisi; Anna Zanghì; Santa Cardillo; Marianna Como; Giuseppa Benedetto; Grazia Spedale; Concetta Musco; Domenica Trecroci; Ubaldina Sfano; Marina Gregorio of Nicolella; Domenica Catalano; Santa Morabito; Giovanna Barbaro; Maria Bellantoni; Maria Bruti; Marianna Bueti; Domenica Pispisa of Solano; Antonina Pistone. Three of the last acts are cropped at the edge of the frame and were read for the surnames only.

name: THE BOURBON MARRIAGE VOLUMES: 1844 HAS AN INDEX, 1845 AND 1846 DO NOT
note: CORRECTED 15 SEPTEMBER. This row first said flatly that the Bourbon-era Scilla marriage volumes carry no annual index. That is true of 1845 and 1846, which simply end at act 32 with the last act — and FALSE OF 1844, which closes with a «TAVOLA annuale alfabetica de' Matrimonj», images 52 to 56, ruled for Num. d'ordine, the SPOUSES, patria, professione, THE PARENTS, and the day of the church celebration. So the run is not uniform and each year must be looked at rather than assumed. The 1844 table is hard going: the Archivio's own cards on it read INCHIOSTRO SBIADITO and GRINZE — faded ink and creases — and it needs contrast-stretching to read at all. The volumes run ONE ACT TO AN IMAGE at about 32 acts a year. Correct arks, since data/scilla-arks.tsv is wrong here: 1842 an_ua2002583 / Lpp8dGV; 1844 an_ua2002588 / 5B6Rqek; 1845 an_ua2002591 / 04rZOPr; 1846 an_ua2002596 / LNolMyl.

name: the Donato sweep, 1845 complete
note: NO DOMENICO DONATO AND NO NUNZIATA SOFI in any of the thirty-two acts of 1845, read one to an image. The year is closed for the target.

name: Michele Donato × Angela de Amico — DOMENICO'S BROTHER
note: CONFIRMED THE NEXT DAY BY THE 1844 TAVOLA. August 1845: «MICHELE DONATO, di anni TRENTUNO, NATO IN MESSINA, MARINARO, domiciliato in Villa, FIGLIO DI CANDELORO DONATO, marinaro, e di [—] PALADINO», marrying ANGELA DE AMICO, 32. This was recorded as a lead and explicitly not a join, for three reasons — the mother was an unmatched Paladino, the man was born at Messina, and Scilla demonstrably held two unrelated Candeloro Donatos. The FIRST of those is now answered: entry 17 of the 1844 Tavola gives Domenico Donato's parents as CANDELORO and MARIA PALADINO. Same father, same mother's surname, same trade, same town. MICHELE IS DOMENICO'S BROTHER, born about 1814 at Messina, and the Michele Donato born at Scilla in 1855 was named for this uncle. It also dates the grandfather: «figlio di» and not «del fu», so CANDELORO DONATO WAS STILL ALIVE in August 1845.

name: the Donato sweep, part of the year
note: NO DONATO among entries 23 to 32 of the annual Tavola, read with the contrast stretched. The couples are Maurizio Giuseppe × Florio Fortunata; Martello Bruno × Bueti Matilde; a Bellantoni; Rossi Giuseppe × Bevilacqua Giulia; Pirri Rosa × Morabito Santo; Colamiti × Pace Antonina; Barbaro Lorenzo × Ciccone Domenica. THE REST OF THE YEAR IS NOT READ — the entries below 23 sit on images before 52 and the ones above 32 on 53R to 56, and the faded ink makes this slow. The Tavola names BOTH PARENTS of both spouses, so finishing it would settle 1844 outright.

name: Domenico Donato × Nunziata Sofi — FOUND
note: THE MARRIAGE, at last. He a MARINARO of Scilla, son of CANDELORO and MARIA PALADINO; she a FILATRICE, daughter of PASQUALE and MARIA DE AMICO; celebrated before the Church in JULY 1844, day 20. Read off the annual Tavola, which is legible where the act is not — the act is 23 or 24 of the year and the ink has gone.

name: SCILLA'S BIRTH VOLUMES DO NOT ALL CARRY AN INDEX — and which ones do decides what a sweep costs
note: A planning fact, established by opening the ends of two volumes rather than assuming. The Scilla Nati series carries an annual «Tavola alfabetica» in SOME years and not others. 1853, 1856, 1859 and 1860 have one — 1856's is bound as a SEPARATE VOLUME from the acts. 1817 HAS NONE: the volume runs 100 images, two acts to an opening, and ends on blank printed forms numbered 160 and 161. 1849 HAS NONE EITHER: 103 images, ending at ACT 200 of 3 November 1849 on a single page. So a year without a Tavola costs about eighty openings to sweep instead of one, and the difference must be checked before promising a search. A TRAP ALONGSIDE IT: Scilla 1849 has TWO arks, and the smaller is not what it looks like. an_ua2002896, 33 images, is not an index — it is a SECOND REGISTER OF THE SAME ACTS carrying the «Indicazione del giorno in cui è stato amministrato il Sagramento del Battesimo» column, mostly blank. The same doubling appears at 1852. WHAT IS LEGIBLE: both 1817 and 1849 read easily at native width — far better than the 1844 marriage Tavola, whose archivist's cards read INCHIOSTRO SBIADITO and GRINZE and which is at the limit of reading even stretched and tripled. Containers found and now kept in data/scilla-arks.tsv, because each one costs an ark page load: Nati 1816 5vEYXqk, 1817 wr9ramX, 1818 wWA7mYX, 1849 w6rZvkO, 1849-suppl 0ZnGMzB, 1850 0MnbP3v, 1851 LeJQDD6, 1852 wX9avAO; Matrimoni 1844 5B6Rqek.

name: THE PROCESSETTI — DOMENICO DONATO AND NUNZIATA SOFI'S OWN BIRTH ACTS, AND THE END OF THE SCILLA LINE
note: THE METHOD THAT BROKE BRIATICO OPEN, APPLIED TO SCILLA, AND IT WORKED. Processetti are the papers filed to get a marriage licence and they contain the BIRTH ACTS OF BOTH SPOUSES. Scilla's bundles were never mapped; they exist for 1817-1819 (sig 1760), 1820-1823 (1761), 1824-1827 (1762), 1832 (1764), 1840-1841 (1766) and 1842-1845 (SIG 1767, an_ua2002480, 1935 images). FINDING THE RIGHT FASCICOLO: the Tavola's «17» for Donato is the alphabetical ROW, not the act. The marriage register itself gives the act — SCILLA, MATRIMONI 1844, ATTO 20 — and the fascicolo number IS the act number, which the Barbaro marriage confirms at both ends (act 17 = fascicolo 17). FASCICOLO 20, images 1194-1199: «Volumetto di documenti pel matrimonio di DOMENICO DONATO e NUNZIATA SOFI», fogli cinque. FOGLIO 1 — Scilla Nati 1816 atto 207: 18 DECEMBER 1816, CANDELORO DONATO, THIRTY-THREE, MARINARO, declares a son born at eleven that morning to «Mar-ta PALADINO», THIRTY. Named DOMENICO. FOGLIO 2 — Scilla Nati 1818 atto 129: November 1818, PASQUALE SOFI, THIRTY-EIGHT, MARINARO, declares a daughter born to MARIA D'AMICO, TWENTY-FIVE. Named NUNZIATA. WHAT IT SETTLES: Domenico's exact birth, matching to the day the thirty-eight he is given in October 1855; Nunziata's; and FOUR AGES never had before — Candeloro born about 1783, Marta Paladino about 1786, Pasquale Sofi about 1780, Maria d'Amico about 1793. WHAT THE ABSENCE SETTLES: five fogli and NO DEATH CERTIFICATE for either father, which this series required when a parent had died (fascicolo 17 of the same year carries «Atti di morte del padre ed avo paterno»). BOTH FATHERS WERE ALIVE IN JULY 1844. AND THE WALL IS NOW EXACT: Candeloro Donato, born about 1783, is the last Donato civil registration can reach. Scilla's registers begin in 1816; his own birth and marriage are earlier, and his son Michele was born at Messina about 1814 where registration does not begin until 1820. Everything above him is parish.

name: FILIPPO ARENA x DOMENICA COSTA — the four-year window, and 1818 is closed
note: THE WINDOW IS FOUR YEARS WIDE AND NO WIDER. Their son FRANCESCO ANTONIO ARENA was born 25 NOVEMBER 1819 and Scilla's civil registration begins in 1816, so either they married between 1816 and 1819 or the marriage is pre-civil and out of reach for good. ALL FOUR YEARS ARE NOW CLOSED AND ALL FOUR ARE NEGATIVE. 1816 AND 1817 HAVE NOW BEEN READ ACT BY ACT -- forty marriages apiece, both volumes carrying the sindaco's own count on the cover («Carte scritte 40») -- AND NEITHER HOLDS A FILIPPO ARENA. SO THE MARRIAGE IS PRE-1816, WHICH MEANS PRE-CIVIL, WHICH MEANS PARISH. FILIPPO ARENA IS WHERE THE ARENA LINE STOPS -- the fourth wall of its kind in this archive, beside Candeloro Donato at Scilla, Pasquale Prostamo at Pizzo, and the nine missing years at Zambrone. THE ARENA WERE IN THE TOWN THROUGHOUT, which is what makes the negative meaningful rather than merely empty: a GIUSEPPE ARENA, marinaro, and ANTONIA POLIMENI give a daughter in marriage in 1816, and a GIUSEPPA ARENA is a bride's mother in 1817. The surname is present in both years; this couple is not. 1818 IS ALSO CLOSED AND NEGATIVE. The volume ends «Il presente Registro per l'anno mille ottocentodiciotto, contenente TRENTATRE Matrimonj, viene chiuso... oggi li trenta Decembre 1818», and its annual Tavola survives across images 41-43. THE COMPLETE F SECTION IS FOUR ENTRIES -- Francesco Migliarino x Antonia Fulco (21 Jan), Francesco Polimeni x Clementina Perina (26 Jan), FILIPPO PIZZARELLO x Francesca Fava (27 Jan), Francesco La Valle x Orsola Florio (10 Apr). NO FILIPPO ARENA. AND A TRAP THAT WOULD HAVE HIDDEN HIM: THE 1818 TAVOLA IS ALPHABETISED BY THE GROOM'S GIVEN NAME, NOT HIS SURNAME. Its A section is Antonio Ararri, D. Antonio Napoli, Antonio Fava, Antonio Caraleo, Antonino Cianone -- five Antonios. Anyone looking for «Arena» under A would find nothing and conclude wrongly. 1819's Tavola, at images 75-79, appears to sort by SURNAME instead: its A section holds ONE entry and it is not Arena. THE KEY CHANGES BETWEEN ADJACENT YEARS. VOLUME SIZES, for whoever finishes this: 1816 is 45 images and closes at FORTY marriages; 1817 is 43 images; 1818 is 43; 1819 is 79. NEITHER 1816 NOR 1817 HAS A TAVOLA IN ITS LAST THREE IMAGES -- both end on the sindaco's closing statement -- so those two years cost about forty images each, read act by act. Containers: 1816 wQYJYDb, 1817 5K9P9J9, 1818 LPaGar8, 1819 0AJEJ8b. *** OVERTAKEN 20 SEPTEMBER, AND THE READING WAS NEVER THE PROBLEM. Every word above about 1816-1819 stands: the years were read, the negatives are sound. THE PREMISE WAS FALSE. Scilla's civil registration begins in 1809, not 1816, and FILIPPO ARENA MARRIED DOMENICA COSTA ON 12 NOVEMBER 1815 -- Matrimoni atto 29, in the fifth napoleonic volume, a fondo this row did not know existed. «Pre-1816» never meant «pre-civil». ***

name: FRANCESCO ANTONIO ARENA — HIS DEATH, 29 AUGUST 1901
note: THE DEATH THIS ARCHIVE HAS BEEN LOOKING FOR SINCE IT FOUND HIM. Scilla, Casa Comunale, 29 AUGUST 1901 at nine fourteen in the morning, before D'Amico Gaetano, assessore delegato. The declarants are CESORIERO DOMENICO, 46, BECCHINO, and FONTANA IGNAZIO, 52, BECCHINO -- two gravediggers, the parish's standard pair, not family. They declared that at SEVEN TEN THAT MORNING, in the house at VIA GROTTE NUMBER TWO, died ARENA FRANCESCO, DI ANNI OTTANTADUE, PESCATORE, resident at Scilla, born at Scilla, son of THE LATE FILIPPO, pescatore, and of THE LATE COSTA DOMENICA, filatrice, and MARITO DI ARLOTTA SERAFINA. THREE IDENTIFIERS LAND TOGETHER AND NO OTHER MAN AT SCILLA CARRIES ALL THREE: father Filippo Arena, mother Domenica Costa, wife Serafina Arlotta. That is act 186 of 1819 and act 228 of 1861 and the marriage of 1851, all three, in one line of a death act. The age is the only soft figure: born 25 November 1819 he was eighty-one years and nine months, entered as eighty-two, which is the usual rounding and not a discrepancy -- the identification does not rest on it. AND IT DATES SERAFINA ARLOTTA FROM THE OTHER SIDE. She is 'Arlotta Serafina' with no 'fu', so she outlived him: her death is after 29 August 1901, and she is absent from the name index that begins in 1911, so it falls in the nine years 1901-1910. THE STREET AGAIN. Via Grotte 2. Fortunato Arena died at Via Grotte 70 and Maria Donato at Via Grotte 21; Giovanni Arena and Michele Donato died sixty yards apart on the same street. Francesco Antonio is the earliest of them, and he is at number two.

name: SERAFINA ARLOTTA — HER DEATH, 24 APRIL 1908, AT THE SAME ADDRESS
note: THE OTHER HALF OF THE ANSWER, SIX AND A HALF YEARS AFTER HER HUSBAND AND IN THE SAME HOUSE. Scilla, Casa Comunale, 24 APRIL 1908 at nine forty-eight in the morning, before D'AMICO VITA ANTONINO, SINDACO. The declarants are ZAGARI FRANCESCO, 46, BECCHINO, and CAROLEI GIUSEPPE, 50, BECCHINO -- two gravediggers again, the same office that declared Francesco Antonio in 1901. They declared that at FOUR O'CLOCK THAT MORNING, in the house at VIA GROTTE NUMBER TWO, died ARLOTTA SERAFINA, DI ANNI SETTANTASETTE, FILATRICE, resident at Scilla, born in this Comune, daughter of THE LATE GIOVANNI, PESCATORE, and of THE LATE COSTA MARIA, TESSITRICE, both domiciled in life at Scilla; VEDOVA DI ARENA ANTONIO. Witnesses PANTILLO GIOVANNI, 47, pescatore, and ROMANO MICHELE, 70, contadino. THE AGE IS EXACT. She was born 13 June 1830, so on 24 April 1908 she was seventy-seven years and ten months, and seventy-seven is what the register says -- unlike her husband, who was rounded up. VIA GROTTE NUMBER TWO IS THE SAME ADDRESS. Francesco Antonio died there on 29 August 1901. She kept the house and died in it, a widow of six years and eight months, with Rocco in America and Giovanni back from it. WHAT IT ADDS THAT WAS NOT KNOWN. Her mother MARIA COSTA gets a trade for the first time -- TESSITRICE, a weaver, not a spinner like almost every other woman in this register -- and both her parents are confirmed dead. Her father GIOVANNI ARLOTTA is PESCATORE here where the 1854 act called him MARINARO: the same late-life drift from sailor to fisherman that Francesco Antonio's acts show. AND THE INDEX CALLED HER BY HER HUSBAND'S NAME. The annual index entry reads «ARENA Serafina, fu Giovanni» -- her MARRIED surname over her father's forename. The act itself says ARLOTTA. This sweep was hunting «Arlotta» in eleven A blocks and found her only because Arena is also an A. A clerk in a comune whose initials did not collide would have hidden her completely. TWO WITNESS SURNAMES WORTH NOTING AND NOT CONCLUDING FROM: PANTILLO -- Pontillo -- and ROMANO stand together at this bedside, and those are the two surnames this archive has in dispute over Camillo Antonio Polistena's mother.

name: ARENA GIOVANNA DIED AT MARSEILLE — NOT ROCCO'S DAUGHTER, AND PARTE II IS A DIASPORA REGISTER
note: THE LEAD FAILS AND THE VOLUME IT FAILED IN IS WORTH MORE THAN THE LEAD. SCILLA, MORTI 1908, PARTE II, ATTO 2, transcribed 11 March 1908 at ten in the morning by D'AMICO VITA ANTONINO, sindaco, on a letter of the third of that month from the PROCURATORE DEL RE of the Tribunale di Reggio Calabria, enclosing a death certificate issued by the SINDACO DI MARSIGLIA on 1 February 1905: ARENA GIOVANNA, FIGLIA DI ROCCO E DI MARTELLO FRANCESCA, DI ANNI NOVE, NATA A SCILLA, died AT MARSEILLE at eleven o'clock on 1 FEBRUARY 1905. NOT ROCCO ARENA'S DAUGHTER. The index line «Arena Giovanna di Rocco» was worth opening because Rocco Arena born 1861 was alive and had children at Scilla. The mother is FRANCESCA MARTELLO, not GENEROSA COSTA. This is a different Arena household and the lead closes. KEEP THE SURNAME THOUGH. Rocco Arena's brother GIUSEPPE married MARIA MARTELLO in 1885. A second Arena married a second Martello. Sisters is the obvious guess and there is nothing here to support it; recorded as a name to watch, not a relationship. AND HERE IS THE REAL FINDING. PARTE II IS WHERE SCILLA'S EMIGRANTS COME HOME. This one opening holds THREE deaths abroad: GULLI ROCCO, 27, bracciante, husband of Lofaro Maria, dead in NEW YORK on 17 August 1907 OF A FRACTURED SKULL, transcribed from an English-language certificate with a translation at his widow's own request; ARENA GIOVANNA at MARSEILLE; and CACCIOLA CARMELA, 7, dead at TUNIS on 26 October 1907 at ten at night. Three continents in four acts. THIS ARCHIVE HAS NEVER OPENED A PARTE II. Rocco Arena crossed to New York four times and Giovanni Arena followed him in 1899. If either of them, or any Arena, Arlotta, Donato or Polistena, had died outside Italy and the family asked for it, THE ACT IS IN A PARTE II AND IT NAMES THE FOREIGN CITY AND THE CAUSE. The parte II sections sit at the back of each volume, immediately before the annual index, and they are short -- 1908 runs to five acts.

name: ARENA COSMO, THREE MONTHS OLD — A CANDIDATE HOUSEHOLD, NOT AN IDENTIFICATION
note: SCILLA, MORTI 1904, PARTE I, ATTO 122. 1 DECEMBER 1904 at eleven fifteen in the morning, before D'AMICO VITA ANTONINO, sindaco. Declarants ZAGARI FRANCESCO, 33, becchino, and CESORIERO DOMENICO, 49, becchino. At HALF PAST SIX THAT MORNING, in the house at VICO SAN MICHELE NUMBER THIRTEEN, died ARENA COSMO, DI MESI TRE CIRCA -- about three months old -- born in this Comune, son of FILIPPO, PESCATORE, of Scilla, and of FARFARI CLEMENTINA, LAVANDAIA, of the same place. Witnesses POLISTINA FRANCESCANTONIO, 72, pescatore, and FARCIA FERDINANDO, 58, giornaliero. WHY IT WAS OPENED AND WHY IT DOES NOT CLOSE. The index line reads «Arena Cosmo DI FILIPPO» -- a LIVING father called Filippo -- and Rocco Arena's eldest brother FILIPPO ARENA was born 14 February 1852 and would be fifty-two. THE ACT GIVES THE FATHER NO AGE. It gives his trade, pescatore, which fits every Arena man in this family, and a wife's name this archive has never seen: CLEMENTINA FARFARI, a laundress. That is a household, not an identification. THE TEST THAT WOULD SETTLE IT is FILIPPO ARENA'S OWN MARRIAGE ACT, which would name his parents. Scilla's civil marriages 1866-1913 are all on Antenati and a man born in 1852 married about 1875-1885. Until then this stays CANDIDATE. ONE THING IT DOES PROVE, sideways. CESORIERO DOMENICO the gravedigger is 46 in August 1901, when he declares Francesco Antonio Arena's death, and 49 here in December 1904 -- three years and four months later, exactly. The same two men buried this parish for over a decade, and declared ages are not always the mess this archive has learned to expect. RESOLVED THE SAME DAY, AND THE ANSWER IS NO. The Antenati name index holds FILIPPO ARENA, dead at Scilla on 17 MARCH 1915: «Padre GIOVANNI ARENA, Madre NATALINA LONGORDO, Coniuge CLEMENTINA FURFARI». That is Cosmo's father, and his parents are Giovanni Arena and Natalina Longordo -- NOT Francesco Antonio Arena and Serafina Arlotta. A second act confirms the household from the other end: ROCCO ARENA, dead 31 March 1938, «Padre Filippo, Madre Clementina Furfari, Coniuge Cristina Como». SO ARENA COSMO IS NOT ROCCO ARENA'S NEPHEW and Rocco's brother Filippo is still unaccounted for. AND THE INDEX CORRECTS MY TRANSCRIPTION: the surname is FURFARI, not Farfari. It is written twice in the index and once, ambiguously, in this act; Furfari is the attested Calabrian surname and Farfari is not. ONE QUERY DID WHAT TEN MARRIAGE VOLUMES WOULD HAVE. The plan here was to sweep Scilla's annual marriage indexes from 1874 to 1885 for Filippo Arena's wedding -- seven of those years would have cost a rate-limited page load each before a single image. The name index answered it in one search because it carries the SPOUSE.

name: ARENA NICOLINA WAS FORTY — THE LEAD CLOSES, AND VIA GROTTE GETS ANOTHER HOUSE
