note: SCILLA, MORTI 1906, PARTE I, ATTO 41. 14 MARCH 1906 at nine twenty-five in the morning, before SISINNI FELICE, SEGRETARIO, delegated by the REGIO COMMISSARIO -- Scilla had no sindaco that spring. Declarants CAROLEO GIUSEPPE, 46, becchino, and FONTANA IGNAZIO, 58, becchino. At HALF PAST FIVE THAT MORNING, in the house at VIA GROTTE NUMBER SEVENTEEN, died ARENA NICOLINA, DI ANNI QUARANTA, FILATRICE, born in this Comune, daughter of GIUSEPPE, PESCATORE, living at Scilla, and of THE LATE ROMANO MARIANNA, filatrice; MOGLIE DI CESORIERO GIUSEPPE. FORTY IS WHAT CLOSES IT. The index line «Arena Nicolina DI GIUSEPPE» was opened because Rocco Arena's brother GIUSEPPE, born 5 March 1860, married Maria Martello in 1885. A daughter of forty in 1906 was born about 1866, when that Giuseppe was six. HE IS A DIFFERENT GIUSEPPE ARENA. SO THERE IS A FOURTH ARENA HOUSEHOLD AT SCILLA: GIUSEPPE ARENA, pescatore, still living in 1906, and MARIANNA ROMANO, filatrice, dead before it -- after Orazio Arena x Giovanna Zirilli, Antonio Arena x Teresa Pontillo, and this archive's own Francesco Antonio x Serafina Arlotta. The surname Arena is not a family at Scilla; it is four families. TWO THREADS WORTH KEEPING. VIA GROTTE AGAIN -- number seventeen, where Francesco Antonio Arena died at number two, Maria Donato at twenty-one and Fortunato Arena at seventy. And the mother is a ROMANO, the surname that is in dispute against Pontillo over Camillo Antonio Polistena's mother, and a ROMANO MICHELE of seventy witnessed Serafina Arlotta's death two years later. Recorded as a recurrence, not a connection.

name: THE ARENA OF SCILLA — ALL TWENTY-SIX INDEXED DEATHS, AND SEVEN HOUSEHOLDS
note: THE WHOLE INDEX, WRITTEN OUT, BECAUSE THE FIRST SWEEP SUMMARISED IT AND THE SUMMARY HID THINGS. Antenati's name index, cognome=Arena, localita=Scilla: 69 indexed persons, TWENTY-SIX of them the deceased. Row 127 named eight and moved on; the answer to today's question -- Filippo Arena -- was sitting in the other eighteen the whole time. All twenty-six, with parents and spouse: Serafina Arena 15.08.1912 (Rocco Arena + Generosa Costa). Grazia Arena 14.02.1913 (Antonio Arena + Serafina De Luca). Teresa Arena 29.06.1913 (Orazio Arena + Giovanna Zirilli; m. Pietro Bova). Annunziato Arena 07.03.1915 (Santo Arena + Giovanna Gioffre; m. Mariantonia Matra). FILIPPO ARENA 17.03.1915 (Giovanni Arena + Natalina Longordo; m. Clementina Furfari). Anna Arena 08.03.1917 (Antonio Arena + Serafina De Luca; m. Rocco Paladino). Maria Arena 25.10.1918 (Rocco Arena + Concetta Lico). Annunziata Arena 12.04.1919 (Antonio + Serafina De Luca). Giovanna Concetta Arena 03.01.1921 (Raffaele Arena + CARMELA MARTELLO). Giuseppe Arena 12.06.1922 (Orazio + Giovanna Zirilli; m. Fortunata Maria Pontillo). Domenico Arena 30.12.1923 (Orazio + MARIANTONIA MUSOLINO). Giuseppe Arena 27.03.1925 (Domenico + TERESA POLISTENA; m. Serafina Vita). Annunziata Arena 08.11.1926 (Raffaele + Mariantonia Cacciola; m. Antonio Fuca). Rocco Maria Arena 22.03.1929 (Santo + Giovanna Gioffre; m. Maria Concetta Lico). ROCCO ARENA 08.02.1932 (Francesco Antonio + Serafina Arlotta; m. Generosa Costa). Antonia Arena 17.03.1932 (mother Giovanna Arena, no father). Maria Annunziata Arena 16.01.1933 (Orazio + Giovanna Zirilli; m. Rocco Chirico). Domenico Arena 12.06.1935 (mother Giovanna Arena, no father). GIOVANNI ARENA 31.03.1936 (Antonio + Serafina Arlotta; m. Concetta Russo). Alessandro Antonio Arena 20.08.1936 (Orazio + Giovanna Zirilli; m. Maria Antonia Lico). Giuseppe Arena 24.07.1937 (GIUSEPPE + MARIANNA ROMANO; m. Maria Scarfone). Salvatore Giuseppe Arena 29.08.1937 (mother Giovanna Arena). Rocco Arena 31.03.1938 (Filippo + Clementina Furfari; m. Cristina Como). Antonia Arena 22.10.1939 (mother Giovanna Arena). Francesca Arena 18.04.1940 (Giuseppe + Carmela Lamari; m. Bruno D'Agostino). Teresa Arena 27.08.1943 (Giuseppe + Serafina Vita; m. Gaetano Cosentino). WHAT THE LIST SHOWS. ARENA IS NOT A FAMILY AT SCILLA; IT IS AT LEAST SEVEN HOUSEHOLDS -- Francesco Antonio x Serafina Arlotta (this archive's line), Orazio x Giovanna Zirilli and then x Mariantonia Musolino, Antonio x Serafina De Luca, Giovanni x Natalina Longordo, Santo x Giovanna Gioffre, Giuseppe x Marianna Romano, Raffaele x Carmela Martello and then x Mariantonia Cacciola, Domenico x Teresa Polistena. Every identification made on the surname alone at Scilla is a one-in-seven guess. IT CONFIRMS THE 1906 ACT INDEPENDENTLY: Giuseppe Arena x Marianna Romano, read there as Nicolina Arena's parents, appear again as the parents of a GIUSEPPE who died in 1937. THREE THINGS TO CARRY. A GIOVANNA ARENA bore FOUR children who died between 1932 and 1939 with NO FATHER NAMED. The MARTELLO women married Arena men at least twice more -- Carmela to Raffaele, and a Francesca to the Rocco whose daughter died at Marseille. And a DOMENICO ARENA married a TERESA POLISTENA, which is the first time this archive's two surnames meet in a register. AND THE SILENCE IS THE FINDING. Of the five sons of Francesco Antonio Arena and Serafina Arlotta, ONLY ROCCO AND GIOVANNI die at Scilla. FILIPPO (b. 1852), DOMENICO (b. 1853) and GIUSEPPE (b. 1860) are in none of these twenty-six, and none of the A blocks of 1897-1908 holds them either. Giuseppe was certainly at Scilla in June 1898, burying his own ten-month-old son. Then nothing.

name: SCILLA HAS 466 REGISTERS, STARTS IN 1809, AND KEEPS TWENTY-TWO VOLUMES OF PROCESSETTI
note: 466 REGISTERS FOR SCILLA, LISTED IN ONE PAGE LOAD, AND TWO OF THIS ARCHIVE'S STANDING BELIEFS ARE WRONG. /search-registry/?localita=Scilla&s_size=500 returns the comune's whole holding: 17 registers in the STATO CIVILE NAPOLEONICO, 182 in the RESTAURAZIONE, 267 in the ITALIANO. ONE. SCILLA'S CIVIL REGISTRATION BEGINS IN 1809, NOT 1816. This archive has been saying 1816 and planning round it. The napoleonic fondo holds Matrimoni and Morti for 1809, Matrimoni, Morti and Nati for 1810, 1811, 1812 and 1815, and Matrimoni for 1813-1814. Seven years nobody here has opened, and they sit exactly where the oldest names on the Scilla side are -- DOMENICO ARLOTTA, dead before April 1854 and born before 1779, and the Filippo Arena generation. TWO. THERE ARE TWENTY-TWO VOLUMES OF MARRIAGE PROCESSETTI, 1810 TO 1865, UNBROKEN -- AND NONE AFTER 1865. Row 64 of the work list is built on opening the bundles behind the Arena marriages of 1885 and 1888. THOSE BUNDLES ARE NOT ON ANTENATI. The Italian-era fondo, all 267 registers of it, holds no processetti at all. That half of row 64 is dead and should be said so rather than left as a plan. BUT THE OTHER HALF IS BETTER THAN THE ROW KNEW. FRANCESCO ANTONIO ARENA AND SERAFINA ARLOTTA MARRIED ON 7 FEBRUARY 1851, ATTO 13 -- and the processetti volume 1849-1852, an_ua2002487, is the bundle for it. A processetti fascicolo carries the BIRTH EXTRACTS OF BOTH SPOUSES and the DEATH ACTS OF DEAD PARENTS, and at Scilla in 1842-1845 it carried a dead GRANDPARENT too. So that one volume is the direct route to FILIPPO ARENA and DOMENICA COSTA (row 68) and to GIOVANNI ARLOTTA and MARIA COSTA (row 39), and possibly to DOMENICO ARLOTTA (row 85) -- three rows, one bundle, and the ark is now in hand. ALL TWENTY-TWO ARKS AND ALL SEVENTEEN NAPOLEONIC ARKS ARE WRITTEN INTO data/scilla-arks.tsv so that nobody pays for this listing again. AND A PARAMETER THAT LIES. /search-registry/?CITTA=Scilla returns ZERO RESULTS with no error and no warning; ?LOCALITA=Scilla returns 466. Exactly the shape of trap already recorded for FindMyPast's `year=` and Antenati's `fq=`. The control test is the only defence: run a query you KNOW returns rows before believing any nil.

name: FRANCESCO ANTONIO ARENA'S BIRTH ACT ITSELF — read at last, and it dates two more generations
note: THE ACT, NOT THE TAVOLA. This archive has carried act 186 of 1819 since it found the line, read off the ANNUAL INDEX. Here is the act, as a certified copy made at Scilla on 10 JANUARY 1851 for use in the marriage of Francesco Arena and Serafina Arlotta, bound into the processetti as foglio 1 of fascicolo 13. SCILLA, 25 NOVEMBER 1819, before D. DOMENICO GULLI, SINDACO, Comune di Scilla, Provincia di Calabria Ultra prima. Appeared FILIPPO ARENA, DI ANNI VENTICINQUE, DI PROFESSIONE MARINARO, domiciled in this Comune, who declared that on that same day AT TWELVE O'CLOCK, in his own house, was born to him and to DOMENICA COSTA, DI ANNI VENTISETTE, his lawful wife, a male child, presented to us, and given the name FRANCESCO. Witnesses D. DOMENICO PALMISANO, 28, NEGOZIANTE, and PIETRO FAMA, 64, MARINARO. The act was read to the declarant and the witnesses and signed by us, by the declarant, and by one witness, THE OTHER HAVING STATED HE COULD NOT WRITE. DATA DEL BATTESIMO: the baptism followed on 26 NOVEMBER 1819 in the Parrocchia di Scilla. WHAT IS NEW AND IT IS TWO GENERATIONS' WORTH. FILIPPO ARENA WAS TWENTY-FIVE, so born about 1794. DOMENICA COSTA WAS TWENTY-SEVEN, so born about 1792. This archive has carried them as «c. 1790s» with no evidence at all; they now have ages from an act in which Filippo appeared in person. AND FILIPPO ARENA COULD WRITE. The act is signed by the declarant. In a register where act after act ends «non si sono meco sottoscritti perche illetterati», the great-great-great-great- grandfather of Mia and Rocco signed his son's birth.

name: SERAFINA ARLOTTA'S BIRTH ACT — AND THE ACT NUMBER THIS ARCHIVE HAS IS WRONG
note: FOGLIO 2 OF THE SAME FASCICOLO, and it corrects the archive twice over. SCILLA, 14 JUNE 1830 at one in the afternoon, before D. GIUSEPPE DE VAZZA, SINDACO, Comune di Scilla, Distretto di Reggio, Provincia della prima Calabria Ulteriore. Appeared GIOVANNI ARLOTTA, DI ANNI QUARANTA, DI PROFESSIONE MARINARO, who presented a female child and declared that she was born to MARIA COSTA, DI ANNI VENTITRE, his lawful wife, living with him, ON THE THIRTEENTH OF THIS MONTH AT TWO IN THE NIGHT, in his own house of habitation; and that he gave the girl the name SERAFINA. Witnesses, produced by Giovanni Arlotta himself: DOMENICO COSTA, DI ANNI QUARANTASEI, COMMERCIANTE REGNICOLO, of this Comune, and D. MICHELANGELO FAVA, DI ANNI VENTIQUATTRO, LEGALE REGNICOLO. ONE. THE ACT NUMBER IS 89, NOT 2. This archive cites «Scilla, Nati 1830 atto 2» in three places. That is a Tavola row number, not an act number -- the same trap already recorded at Briatico, where the 1828 index ran one behind the register. The date it gives, 13 JUNE 1830, is right. TWO. THE FATHER'S AGE CONFLICTS WITH HIS OWN LATER DECLARATION BY ELEVEN YEARS. He is FORTY here in June 1830, so born about 1790. In April 1854, declaring his grandson Giovanni's birth, he is SEVENTY-FIVE, so born about 1779. Both are his own statements, made in person, and both call him marinaro. This archive carries c. 1779. The conflict is recorded, not resolved. THREE. MARIA COSTA WAS TWENTY-THREE, so born about 1807 -- her first date of any kind. FOUR, AND IT IS A LEAD. The first witness, produced by the father, is DOMENICO COSTA, COMMERCIANTE, FORTY-SIX -- born about 1784, which makes him twenty-three when Maria Costa was born. A father-in-law standing at his granddaughter's registration is the ordinary reading, and it is a reading, not a finding. AND THE COMPANY IS WORTH NOTING. Giovanni Arlotta is «SIG.» in this act and his witnesses are a merchant and a lawyer. The Arena of the same decade are marinari with becchini for witnesses.

name: THE MARRIAGE BUNDLE OF 7 FEBRUARY 1851 — FOUR SHEETS, AND WHAT IS ABSENT FROM THEM
note: SCILLA, PROCESSETTI 1849-1852, container 58rXBoX, 1845 images. FASCICOLO 13 OF 1851 BEGINS AT IMAGE 1190 and its wrapper reads: «Scilla 1851 / Num. 13 / Volumetto de documenti pel matrimonio di FRANCESCO ARENA e SERAFINA ARLOTTA / Indice: Atto di nascita delli Sposi f. 1-2; Atto di notificazione senza opposizione 3; Certificato della celebrazione canonica 4. FOGLI QUATTRO.» WHAT IS ABSENT IS EVIDENCE. Four sheets, and NO DEATH ACT OF ANY PARENT. The neighbouring fascicolo 3 of the same year, at image 1100, lists «Atto di morte del padre e dell'avo paterno dello Sposo, f. 3-4» -- so this office DID bind in the death acts when a parent or grandparent was dead. Their absence here is the ordinary reading that FILIPPO ARENA, DOMENICA COSTA, GIOVANNI ARLOTTA and MARIA COSTA WERE ALL FOUR ALIVE ON 7 FEBRUARY 1851. CAVEAT, AND IT IS REAL: Serafina was twenty and needed parental consent, and no «consenso» sheet is listed either, so consent was evidently given in person at the ceremony rather than on paper. An argument from a four-line index is weaker than an act. Graded as a reading. HOW TO NAVIGATE THIS VOLUME, because it cost a dozen probes to learn. The four years are NOT evenly spread and the fascicoli are NOT one per image-block of fixed size. What works: each fascicolo opens with a WRAPPER -- a nearly blank left page and a short centred list on the right -- and those wrappers are findable by shape in a montage of thumbnails at width 430, without reading a word. In 1851 they fall at images 1100 (num. 3), 1190 (num. 13), 1280 (num. 24) and 1430 (num. 37): about nine images per fascicolo, and the interior is loose. DO NOT navigate by the «Num. d'ordine» on the atti di notificazione inside -- those are a separate publication series running at a different rate, and following them sends you to the wrong year.

name: GIOVANNI ARLOTTA x MARIA COSTA, 7 SEPTEMBER 1828 — AND THE AGES ARE NOT WHAT THIS ARCHIVE HAS
father: fu Domenico Arlotta and Anna Barbaro
note: SCILLA, 30 AUGUST 1828, at twenty-three o'clock, in the Casa comunale, before FEDELE IDA', SECONDO ELETTO ed Uffiziale dello Stato Civile del Comune di Scilla, Distretto di Reggio, Provincia della prima Calabria Ulteriore. GIOVANNI ARLOTTA, DI ANNI VENTOTTO, born in this Comune, MARINARO, domiciled here, FIGLIO DI FU DOMENICO ARLOTTA and of ANNA VARBARO -- BARBARO -- domiciled here. AND MARIA COSTA, D'ANNI VENTISEI, born in this Comune, FIGLIA DI ROCCO DI COSTA, MARINARO, domiciled here, AND OF PASQUALINA IDONE, domiciled here. The banns were posted on the door of the Casa comunale on SUNDAY 3 AUGUST; the church wedding followed on 7 SEPTEMBER 1828 before D. DOMENICO ZANGHI and BRUNO INGRIGNERI. AND THE BRIDE'S PARENTS STOOD THERE AND SAID SO: «e cio sotto l'assistenza dei genitori della sposa, li quali sono intervenuti al presente atto ed hanno dichiarato il di loro espresso e formale consenso». ROCCO COSTA AND PASQUALINA IDONE WERE BOTH ALIVE ON 30 AUGUST 1828 and in the room. WHAT IT BREAKS, AND IT BREAKS SOMETHING THIS ARCHIVE WROTE TODAY. GIOVANNI ARLOTTA IS TWENTY-EIGHT HERE, so born about 1800. His daughter's birth act of 1830 makes him FORTY; his grandson's of 1854 makes him SEVENTY-FIVE. THREE OF HIS OWN DECLARATIONS, THREE BIRTH YEARS, SPANNING TWENTY-ONE. This act is the strongest of the three: it is his own marriage, where age carried legal weight, and it names his parents, which the others do not both do. Twenty-eight in August 1828 makes him THIRTY in June 1830 -- «trenta» misread or miswritten as «quaranta» is the ordinary explanation. The 1854 «settantacinque» is not explicable that way and stays a problem: either a badly wrong age, or a SECOND Giovanni Arlotta son of a late Domenico. MARIA COSTA IS TWENTY-SIX HERE, so born about 1802. THIS ARCHIVE ENTERED HER AS «c. 1807» EARLIER TODAY, off the same 1830 act that makes her twenty-three. Her own marriage act, with her parents standing beside her, outranks her husband's statement at a registration desk. CORRECTED TO c. 1802 AND THE OLD FIGURE RECORDED RATHER THAN QUIETLY REPLACED. WHAT IT ADDS. ANNA BARBARO, Giovanni Arlotta's mother, alive in 1828 -- a name this archive has never held. ROCCO COSTA, marinaro, and PASQUALINA IDONE, Maria Costa's parents, both alive in 1828 -- likewise. AND DOMENICO ARLOTTA WAS ALREADY DEAD IN AUGUST 1828, twenty-six years earlier than the «before April 1854» this archive has carried. He is confirmed, not dislodged.

name: THE 1828 MARRIAGE TAVOLA NAMES BOTH SPOUSES' PARENTS — AND IT DOCUMENTS THE OTHER ARENA HOUSEHOLD
note: «TAVOLA annuale alfabetica de' Matrimonj per l'anno 1828», images 57-59 of container 0AJEAeg, fifty-one marriages. ITS COLUMNS ARE Num. d'ordine | Cognomi e Nomi degli Sposi | Patria | COGNOMI E NOMI DE' GENITORI | Giorno della celebrazione -- so ONE INDEX PAGE GIVES FOUR PARENTS PER MARRIAGE, and the act need only be opened when the ages matter. This is the Zambrone pattern, at Scilla. ENTRY 2 IS WHAT WAS WANTED: «ARLOTTA GIOVANNI e COSTA MARIA -- Scilla -- fu Dom.co e Barbaro Anna / Rocco e Idone Pasqualina -- 7 7bre 1828 -- 28». ENTRY 1 IS A BONUS AND IT CLOSES A GUARD WRITTEN THIS MORNING: «ARENA ANTONIO e DE LUCA SERAFINA -- Scilla -- ORAZIO e MORABITO LETTERIA / FILIPPO e ALFONZETTI ANNA -- 10 Ag.o 1828 -- 26». THAT IS THE OTHER ANTONIO ARENA, the one whose wife is also called Serafina and who has been confused with this archive's Francesco Antonio Arena. HIS PARENTS ARE ORAZIO ARENA AND LETTERIA MORABITO -- which is where the name ORAZIO in that family comes from, and why their son Orazio, who died at Scilla in 1895, was once taken for the tree's Orazio Arena. The two households are now separated by four named parents and a wedding date, not by a caution. 1829 HAS NO A SECTION AT ALL: its Tavola opens at B with entry 1 (Battaglia Ferdinando), so no Arena and no Arlotta married at Scilla that year. A TRAP AVOIDED, AND THE TOOL NOW HANDLES IT. Asking IIIF for width=1800 on these BOURBON-ERA scans returns 403 FORBIDDEN, because the scan is smaller than that and the service refuses to upscale. It reads exactly like the site's rate limiter and is nothing of the kind -- the limiter only ever touches HTML. tools/antenati_index.py now falls back to /full/ on a 403.

name: ANNUNZIATA POLISTINA — CAMILLO ANTONIO'S SISTER, AND THE INDEX WAS WRONG ABOUT HER MOTHER
note: THE TAVOLA WAS WRONG AND THE DEATH ACT WAS RIGHT. Scilla, 2 DECEMBER 1836 at twenty-one hundred, before GIACOMO MINASI, SINDACO. Appeared TERESA ARENA, DI ANNI QUARANTAQUATTRO, LEVATRICE -- a MIDWIFE -- who presented a female child and declared that she was born to ANNA PONTILLO, DI ANNI TRENTACINQUE, lawful wife of GIUSEPPE POLISTINA, DI ANNI TRENTOTTO, MARINARO, on THE SECOND OF THIS MONTH AT EIGHT O'CLOCK, in the couple's own house; and that the girl was given the name ANNUNZIATA POLISTINA. Witnesses FILIPPO PALADINO, 70, marinaro, and DOMENICO CALIOTA, 49, FORNARO -- a baker -- both produced by the midwife. The declarant could not write. WHAT IT SETTLES. The 1836 annual Tavola enters this child as «Polistina Annunziata, di GIUSEPPE e MARTELLO ANNA». THE ACT SAYS ANNA PONTILLO. Camillo Antonio Polistena's death act of 1924 names his parents GIUSEPPE POLISTENA and ANNA PONTILLO -- so the index was wrong, the death act was right, AND ANNUNZIATA POLISTINA IS CAMILLO ANTONIO'S SISTER. THE GUESS ABOUT WHY THE INDEX ERRED HELD UP. Four entries earlier in the same P section stands «PONTILLO Giovanni, di Giuseppe e Paladino Giuseppa». The clerk copying that column had a Pontillo and a Polistina under his hand within four lines and put the wrong surname on the wrong mother. AND IT DATES TWO GENERATION-SEVEN PEOPLE WHO HAD NO DATES AT ALL. GIUSEPPE POLISTENA, THIRTY-EIGHT in December 1836, so born about 1798, and a MARINARO -- which sets the Polistena beside the Arena and the Arlotta as another Scilla sailing family. ANNA PONTILLO, THIRTY-FIVE, so born about 1801. A SECOND METHOD FINDING, AND IT IS THE REASON THIS ACT TOOK TWO PROBES. THE 1836 BIRTH TAVOLA CARRIES NO ACT NUMBER AT ALL. Its columns are Num. d'ordine | Cognomi e Nomi dei Nati | Cognomi e Nomi dei Genitori | GIORNO DELLA NASCITA, and the «Num. d'ordine» is the INDEX ROW, running 1 to 222 across the alphabet. Act 191 of the register is a SQUILLACI birth at Solano. THE ONLY KEY FROM THIS INDEX INTO THIS REGISTER IS THE DATE OF BIRTH, and the acts are in date order. ONE THING NOTED AND NOT CONCLUDED FROM: the midwife who delivered this child and swore the act is called TERESA ARENA.

name: ROCCO POLISTINA — THE ACT, AND A MARRIAGE WRITTEN IN THE MARGIN THIRTY-SIX YEARS LATER
note: SCILLA, ATTO 174 OF 1833, READ IN FULL -- and the register keeps annotating itself for another thirty-six years. 15 DECEMBER 1833 at sixteen hundred, before GUGLIELMO ZAGARI, DECURIONE FUNZIONANTE DA SINDACO. Appeared TERESA ARENA, DI ANNI TRENTOTTO, LEVATRICE -- THE SAME MIDWIFE who would deliver this child's sister Annunziata three years later -- who presented a male child and declared that he was born to ANNA PONTILLO, DI ANNI TRENTATRE, lawful wife of GIUSEPPE POLISTINA, DI ANNI TRENTAQUATTRO, MARINARO, ON THE THIRTEENTH OF THIS MONTH AT SIX O'CLOCK, in the couple's own house; and that the boy was given the name ROCCO POLISTINA. Witnesses FRANCESCO DI FRANCO, 48, SCALPELLINO -- a stonecutter -- and ROSARIO CAVIOLA, 47, both produced by the midwife. THE AGES CROSS-CHECK THE OTHER ACT EXACTLY. Giuseppe Polistina is THIRTY-FOUR in December 1833 and THIRTY-EIGHT in December 1836; Anna Pontillo is THIRTY-THREE and then THIRTY-FIVE. Three years of register, four and two years of declared age -- the ordinary slop, and both readings land on GIUSEPPE BORN 1798-99 and ANNA BORN 1800-01. Two independent acts, no conflict. AND THE MARGIN CARRIES A MARRIAGE. «L'anno 1869, il giorno 12 Luglio -- il sottoscritto Uffiziale dello Stato Civile dichiara che ROCCO POLISTINA, cui ha rapporto il contro scritto atto di nascita, HA CONTRATTO MATRIMONIO IN QUESTO COMUNE CON COLORINA BRI[...] nel giorno 12 andante mese ed anno. L'Uffiziale G. Zagari. Reggio 26 Agosto 1869.» SO ROCCO POLISTINA LIVED TO THIRTY-FIVE AND MARRIED AT SCILLA ON 12 JULY 1869. The bride's surname is cut by the binding and her forename reads COLORINA or COLOMBA -- recorded as read, uncertain, because the marriage act of 1869 will give it plainly and this archive has been caught before by a name guessed off a margin. WHAT THE ANNOTATION IS WORTH BEYOND ITSELF: a Scilla birth act of the restaurazione carries MARGINAL NOTES ADDED DECADES LATER, and nobody here has been reading them. Camillo Antonio Polistena's own birth act, wherever it is, may well carry his marriage in the same hand.

name: SERAFINA ARLOTTA'S ACT IN THE REGISTER ITSELF — and the margin is blank
note: THE REGISTER'S OWN COPY, against the certified copy read in the 1851 processetti, AND THEY AGREE WORD FOR WORD. Scilla, 14 JUNE 1830 at thirteen hundred, before D. GIUSEPPE DE NIZZA, SINDACO. GIOVANNI ARLOTTA, DI ANNI QUARANTA, MARINARO, presented a female child born to MARIA COSTA, DI ANNI VENTITRE, his lawful wife, on the THIRTEENTH at TWO IN THE NIGHT in his own house, and named her SERAFINA. Witnesses DOMENICO COSTA, 46, COMMERCIANTE, and D. MICHELANGELO FAVA, 24, LEGALE. So the chancery copy of 1851 was faithful, which is worth knowing -- this archive has already met a Pizzo extract that lost ten years off a man's age. AND THE MARGIN IS EMPTY. She married on 7 FEBRUARY 1851 and NOTHING WAS EVER WRITTEN BACK INTO HER BIRTH ACT. Against Rocco Polistina's act of 1833, whose margin carries his 1869 marriage, that is the beginning of a rule rather than a disappointment: see the 1852 act.

name: FILIPPO ARENA'S ACT IN THE REGISTER — a blank margin, and the worst declared ages yet
note: READ IN THE REGISTER FOR THE FIRST TIME -- this archive has carried act 48 of 1852 off the annual Tavola alone. Scilla, 14 FEBRUARY 1852 at sixteen hundred, before GAETANO FERRANTE, SINDACO. ANTONIO ARENA, DI ANNI TRENTASEI, MARINARO, presented a male child born to SERAFINA ARLOTTA, DI ANNI VENTOTTO, his lawful wife, that same day at eight o'clock in his own house, and named him FILIPPO. Witnesses ROCCO PIZZARELLO, 30, FERRARO -- a blacksmith -- and TOMMASO CARDONA, 30, FALEGNAME -- a carpenter. THE DECLARANT COULD NOT WRITE. THE AGES ARE THE WORST THIS ARCHIVE HAS MET IN ONE ACT. Francesco Antonio Arena was born 25 NOVEMBER 1819, so he was THIRTY-TWO in February 1852, not thirty-six. Serafina Arlotta was born 13 JUNE 1830, so she was TWENTY-ONE, not twenty-eight -- and she had married at TWENTY, twelve months earlier, on an act that says so. FOUR YEARS AND SEVEN YEARS OUT, IN THE SAME LINE. Two years later, in atto 76 of 1854, the same couple are entered as THIRTY-FOUR and TWENTY-TWO, which fits. So the register did not age them; the clerk simply guessed, and guessed badly. THE IDENTIFICATION IS NOT AT RISK and rests where it always did: the pairing ANTONIO ARENA x SERAFINA ARLOTTA, which is unique at Scilla, and the naming of the child FILIPPO for his grandfather. But this act is the reason declared ages are graded here and never used alone. AND THE MARGIN IS BLANK. Filippo Arena would have married after 1866 if he married at Scilla at all, and nothing was written back. See the correction filed with this row for what that is and is not worth.

name: DOMENICA, NOT DOMENICO — a sister carried as a brother, and the act number was an index row
note: THE CHILD IS A DAUGHTER, AND THIS ARCHIVE HAS CARRIED HER AS A SON. SCILLA, ATTO 53 OF 1853 -- NOT ATTO 2. 24 MARCH 1853 at sixteen hundred, before FRANCESCO PALMISANO, SINDACO. Appeared FRANCESCANTONIO ARENA, DI ANNI TRENTADUE, MARINARO -- his name written out in full -- who presented UNA FEMINA born to SERAFINA ARLOTTA, SUA MOGLIE LEGITTIMA, DI ANNI VENTIDUE, that same day at twelve o'clock in his own house, AND DECLARED «DI DARE ALLA FANCIULLA IL NOME DI DOMENICA». The Indicazione column confirms it a third time: the baptism was administered to DOMENICA ARENA on the twenty-fourth. Witnesses GIUSEPPE IDONE, 40, and NUNZIO MATRA, 40, MARINARO, produced by Francescantonio Arena himself. SO «DOMENICO ARENA, b. 24 MARCH 1853, ROCCO ARENA'S BROTHER» IS DOMENICA ARENA, HIS SISTER. Three independent statements inside one act -- femina, fanciulla, and the baptismal name -- and no ambiguity in any of them. IT ALSO EXPLAINS A SILENCE. Row 146 records that three of Rocco Arena's four brothers vanish from Scilla's registers after 1898. ONE OF THE THREE WAS NEVER A BROTHER: a daughter who married would leave the Arena surname and stop appearing under it, which is not a disappearance at all. AND THE AGES HERE ARE EXACT, WHICH MATTERS AFTER THE 1852 ACT. Francescantonio is THIRTY-TWO in March 1853 and was born 25 November 1819 -- exact. Serafina is TWENTY-TWO and was born 13 June 1830 -- exact. Fourteen months earlier the same clerk's office made them thirty-six and twenty-eight. The register is not drifting; individual acts are simply right or wrong, and this one is right. THE CITATION WAS A TAVOLA ROW NUMBER, AGAIN. «Scilla, Nati 1853 atto 2» has been carried here and published. ACT 2 OF 1853 IS DOMENICA BELLANTONI, born 4 January to Maria Bellantoni, filatrice, twenty-nine, who acknowledged her as her natural daughter. «2» was the second entry in the A block of the annual Tavola -- the same trap that made Serafina Arlotta's «atto 2» of 1830 out of act 89.

name: GIUSEPPE ARENA'S ACT — and an empty MENZIONI box that breaks yesterday's inference
note: GIUSEPPE ARENA'S BIRTH ACT, AND IT BREAKS AN INFERENCE THIS ARCHIVE MADE AN HOUR AGO. SCILLA, ACT 45 OF 1860 -- and here the Tavola number IS the act number, unlike 1830 and 1853. 6 MARCH 1860 at sixteen hundred, before GUGLIELMO ZAGARI, SINDACO. Appeared GIUSEPPA DE GIROLAMO, figlia di Giuseppe, DI ANNI VENTITRE, LEVATRICE -- a midwife -- domiciled at Scilla, who presented a MASCHIO born to SERAFINA ARLOTTA, DI ANNI VENTINOVE, and to FRANCESCO ANTONIO ARENA, MARINARO, on the FIFTH of that month at ten o'clock in their own house, and named GIUSEPPE. Present: D. FRANCESCO ANTONIO ILA, sixty-eight, PROPRIETARIO, and D. GIUSEPPE IDONE, SERVENTE COMUNALE. THE DATE CONFIRMS THE ARCHIVE EXACTLY -- born 5 March 1860, declared the 6th -- and SERAFINA ARLOTTA AT TWENTY-NINE IS EXACT for a birth on 13 June 1830. The father's age is written low and does not fit a man of forty; it is left as read and not relied on, which is now the standing practice for this register. AND THE MENZIONI BOX IS EMPTY. The 1860 form does not use the left-hand MARGINE of the 1850s volumes; it carries a right-hand box headed «MENZIONI prescritte dagli articoli 64, 65 e 106, LL. CC. e dagli altri Regolamenti in vigore» -- the same purpose, a different place. IT IS BLANK FOR ACT 45 AND FOR ACT 44 BESIDE IT. GIUSEPPE ARENA MARRIED MARIA MARTELLO AT SCILLA ON 12 SEPTEMBER 1885, atto 73, which this archive has read in the original. HIS BIRTH ACT WAS NEVER ANNOTATED. So a blank annotation box does NOT mean «did not marry at Scilla», and the reading filed against Filippo Arena an hour earlier is withdrawn. ONE CAUTION TO SOFTEN TOO: this archive records that when the declarant is a LEVATRICE the act names the parents WITHOUT ages. Here a levatrice declared and BOTH ages are given. The caution is a tendency, not a rule.

name: POLISTINA LUIGI CARMELO x MATRA NUNZIATA, 23 NOVEMBER 1882 — a Donato-Polistena marriage dated
mother: Giacomo Matra and the late Concetta Leotta
note: A DONATO-POLISTENA MARRIAGE, DATED AT LAST -- and found by using the margin-strip trick this archive had written down and then failed to use. SCILLA, 23 NOVEMBER 1882 at five forty in the afternoon, in the Casa Comunale, before MINASI FRANCESCO, ASSESSORE DELEGATO DAL SINDACO by an act of 25 October 1879. 1o POLISTINA LUIGI CARMELO, DI ANNI TRENTA, MARINAIO, NATO IN QUESTO COMUNE, resident here, FIGLIO DI RAFFAELE, resident in this Comune, E DI TERESA DONATO, resident here. 2o MATRA NUNZIATA, FILATRICE, NATA IN QUESTO COMUNE, resident here, FIGLIA DI GIACOMO, resident in this Comune, E DELLA FU CONCETTA LEOTTA, resident in life at Scilla. IT MATCHES THE NAME INDEX EXACTLY. «Luigi Polistena, d. 8 DECEMBER 1933 -- Padre RAFFAELE, Madre TERESA DONATO, Coniuge ANNUNZIATA MATRA.» Same man, from the other end of his life, fifty-one years apart. The identification is closed. WHAT IT ADDS. Luigi Carmelo Polistina was BORN AT SCILLA about 1852 and was a MARINAIO -- the Polistena on the water again, like Giuseppe Polistena in 1836. RAFFAELE POLISTENA AND TERESA DONATO WERE BOTH ALIVE IN NOVEMBER 1882, which is the first date of any kind either has had. And ANNUNZIATA MATRA'S parents are named: GIACOMO MATRA, living, and the late CONCETTA LEOTTA. AND IT DATES ONE OF THE FOUR DONATO-POLISTENA MARRIAGES. Row 138 records four ties between these two families across two generations and two hemispheres; this is the first of them with a day on it. NOTE WHICH GENERATION: Teresa Donato is the MOTHER here, so the Donato-Polistena join in this line happened a generation EARLIER still, and her own marriage to Raffaele Polistena is now a named target -- before about 1852.

name: CAMILLO ANTONIO POLISTENA x GIOVANNA ROMANO, 23 JANUARY 1881 — and he is NINE YEARS younger than this archive thought
father: the late Giuseppe Polistena and the late Anna Pontillo
note: THE ACT ROW 155 WAS BUILT TO FIND, AND IT BREAKS THE AGE THIS ARCHIVE HAS CARRIED. SCILLA, 23 JANUARY 1881 at six seventeen in the evening, in the Casa comunale, before MINASI FRANCESCO, ASSESSORE DELEGATO DAL SINDACO. 1o POLISTINA CAMILLO ANTONIO, DI ANNI TRENTASEI, MARINARO, NATO IN QUESTO COMUNE, resident here, FIGLIO DEL FU GIUSEPPE, resident in life at Scilla, E DELLA FU ANNA PONTILLO, resident in life at Scilla. 2o ROMANO GIOVANNA, DI ANNI VENTISEI, FILATRICE, NATA IN QUESTO COMUNE, resident here, FIGLIA DI ANNUNZIATO, resident in this Comune, E DI ANGELA ZIRILLI, resident here. FIVE THINGS AT ONCE. ONE, THE MARRIAGE IS DATED: 23 JANUARY 1881, act 4. This archive had it only as «about 1870-1882». TWO, HE WAS BORN AT SCILLA. «Nato in questo Comune», in his own marriage act. So the birth act exists and sixteen years of the birth register failed to find it. THREE, AND THIS IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS: HE WAS THIRTY-SIX, SO BORN ABOUT 1844 -- between late January 1844 and late January 1845. HIS SON'S BIRTH ACT OF SEPTEMBER 1883 MAKES HIM FORTY-EIGHT, WHICH IS A BIRTH ABOUT 1835. NINE YEARS APART, both from his own household. The 1835 figure is what sent this archive through eleven years of birth registers on the wrong side of the answer. AND 1844 IS INSIDE THE SWEEP. The 1844 P block was read and holds two Polistina -- Rocco di Domenico, and Giuseppe di Francesco -- and no Camillo Antonio; but that reading covered entries 127 to 138 and DID NOT ESTABLISH WHERE THE P BLOCK ENDS. And 1845 is on record here as PARTIAL, with SEVEN OF EIGHTEEN LINES TOO FAINT TO READ. Both years need going back to. FOUR, BOTH HIS PARENTS WERE ALREADY DEAD. «Il fu Giuseppe» and «la fu Anna Pontillo» -- so GIUSEPPE POLISTENA AND ANNA PONTILLO DIED BEFORE 23 JANUARY 1881, which is the first bound either has ever had. It also confirms the parentage from a SECOND document, forty-three years before the death act of 1924 that first gave it. FIVE, GIOVANNA ROMANO IS DATED AND HER PARENTS CONFIRMED: twenty-six, a FILATRICE, born at Scilla about 1854, daughter of ANNUNZIATO ROMANO and ANGELA ZIRILLI, BOTH LIVING in January 1881. This archive settled her surname against the tree's «Pontillo» on three records; here is a fourth, and the only one where she is the subject. AND THE METHOD: found by the margin-strip montage. Images 2-7 of this volume give acts 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11 in the left margin WITH BOTH SPOUSES' NAMES, so act 4 is the right-hand act of image 3. Two calls, no guessing.

name: CAMILLO ANTONIO POLISTENA, BORN 21 SEPTEMBER 1844 — found four entries past where I stopped
note: FOUND, AND IT WAS FOUR ENTRIES PAST WHERE I STOPPED READING. The 1844 annual birth Tavola, entry 142: «POLISTINA CAMILLO -- GIUSEPPE e PONTILLO ANNA -- 21 SETTEMBRE». SO CAMILLO ANTONIO POLISTENA WAS BORN AT SCILLA ON 21 SEPTEMBER 1844, son of Giuseppe Polistena and Anna Pontillo -- the couple named on his marriage act of 1881 and his death act of 1924. THE ARITHMETIC IS EXACT AND THAT IS WHAT CLOSES IT. Born 21 September 1844, he was THIRTY-SIX YEARS AND FOUR MONTHS on 23 January 1881, and his marriage act says «di anni trentasei». On 16 September 1883, at his son Giovanni's birth, he was THIRTY-EIGHT years and eleven months -- and that act entered him as FORTY-EIGHT. TEN YEARS WRONG, and this archive built a sixteen-year sweep of the birth registers on it. HOW IT WAS MISSED, WHICH IS WORTH MORE THAN THE FINDING. The 1844 P block was read earlier the same day. The crop covered entries 127 to 138 and stopped, WITHOUT ESTABLISHING WHERE THE BLOCK ENDED -- and I wrote that gap down in the row as a known weakness rather than closing it. He is at 142. THE P BLOCK RUNS TO 150. A partial reading recorded as a negative is the same error as a 403 recorded as a nil, and it cost eleven further years of sweeping. AND THE ENTRY BESIDE HIM IS A FIFTH HOUSEHOLD: 143, «POLISTINA TOMMASO -- D. ANTONIO e PALADINO ANNUNZIATA -- 4 8bre». The «D.» is DON, so that branch had some standing. Added to Giuseppe x Anna Pontillo, Francesco x Giuseppa Longardo, Luigi x Marianna Baviera and Domenico x Caterina Costa. STILL TO DO: the ACT itself. This Tavola gives no act number and the register runs in date order, so a birth of 21 September 1844 is two or three probes away in container LNolOVK -- and the act will give both parents' AGES, which would date Giuseppe Polistena and Anna Pontillo a third time, and may carry a marriage annotation in its margin.

name: CAMILLO ANTONIO POLISTENA'S BIRTH ACT — 21 September 1844, and his marriage is in the margin
note: THE ACT, AT LAST, AND IT IS 137 -- NOT 142, WHICH WAS THE TAVOLA'S ROW NUMBER. SCILLA, SEPTEMBER 1844, before GAETANO MINASI, SINDACO. Appeared GIUSEPPE POLISTINA, DI ANNI CINQUANTA, MARINARO, domiciled in this Comune, who presented a MASCHIO and declared that he was born to ANNA PONTILLO, FILATRICE, HIS LAWFUL WIFE, domiciled with him, NEL GIORNO VENTUNO CORRENTE MESE -- ON THE TWENTY-FIRST -- and that he gave the boy THE NAME OF CAMILLO ANTONIO. The Indicazione column records the baptism of CAMILLO ANTONIO POLISTINA. Witness: TOMMASO CARDONA. SO: CAMILLO ANTONIO POLISTENA, BORN AT SCILLA ON 21 SEPTEMBER 1844. The Tavola was right about the date and the parents, and wrong -- as always in this series -- about the number. THE GIVEN NAME IS SETTLED TOO. The index says «Camillo»; the act says «CAMILLO ANTONIO», which is what every later record calls him. He was christened with both. AND THE MARGIN CARRIES HIS MARRIAGE. The MARGINE column holds a long annotation ending «Scilla 25 Gennaio 1881» -- two days after the wedding of 23 January 1881 recorded in Matrimoni 1881 atto 4. So the margin practice DID reach him, and the two acts point at each other across thirty-seven years. THE FATHER'S AGE DRIFTS AGAIN AND IS NOT RELIED ON. Giuseppe Polistina is FIFTY here in September 1844, THIRTY-EIGHT in December 1836 and THIRTY-FOUR in December 1833 -- three declarations giving births of 1794, 1798 and 1799. The two earlier ones agree with each other; this one does not, and it is recorded rather than averaged. HOW IT WAS FOUND, AFTER FIVE ACTS HAD BEEN OPENED ONE AT A TIME AND WASTED: two montages. One of the EVEN acts across images 68-77 mapped September to acts 129-143 and October from 144. One of the ODD acts across images 68-73 put a POLISTINA at act 137. The whole hunt should have been those two calls.

name: Filippo Arena x Domenica Costa
father: Orazio Arena, marinaro, present and consenting; and the late Giovanni Costa, d. Scilla 29 March 1790
mother: Setteria Morabito, present and consenting; and Marta Alfonzetti, present and consenting
note: THE ACT THIS ARCHIVE SAID DID NOT EXIST. 12 November 1815, hour 22, before Tommaso Cutelle, sindaco. Filippo Arena, TWENTY-TWO, marinaro, «figlio MINORE assistito da suoi genitori Orazio Arena della stessa professione e Setteria Morabito, domiciliati come sopra, presente all'atto e dando il loro consenso». Domenica Costa, TWENTY-EIGHT, «figlia maggiore del fu Giovanni, morto in questa Comune a 29 Marzo 1790, come costa dall'atto di morte che si conserva, e di Marta Alfonzetti, domiciliata come sopra, presente all'atto e dando il suo consenso». Banns 17 and 24 September. Witnesses Giovanni Cuzzo 47 impiegato militare, Francesco Macri 28 civile, Vincenzo Ochoa 32, Francesco Principato 44. AND FILIPPO SIGNED IT: «Filippo Arena sposo», the same hand that signed his son's birth act four years later.

name: volume sweep for Filippo Arena
note: COMPLETE, AND THE HIT IS AT ACT 29. Thirty-two marriages, no Tavola, one act to an opening, image p carrying act p-2. Read by montage of the act head -- number, date, groom, groom's father -- at pct:52,18,46,26. Act 33 is a blank form under a WATER DAMAGE card, and beneath it the closing statement: «Il presente Registro de' Matrimonj contenente N.o TRENTADUE dell'anno mille ottocento...». So the volume's end was found and the reading is whole. Act 13, also under a card, was re-cropped lower and reads Paolo Cacciola, 23, bracciale, son of Filippo Cacciola and Santa Panuccia. Grooms in order: [1] Domenico di Nunzio, Pizzarello, Arlotta, Olivieri, Briganti, Bueti, Fava, Polistina, Fava, di Franco, Carrozza, Fava, Cacciola, Como, Sclari, La Rosa, Morabito, Longordo, Musco, Angi, Forte Buono, Minasi, Tuzzo, Romeo, Cappillo, Cosenz, Longordo, Minoriti, ARENA, Cacciola, Paladino, di Girolamo [32].

name: volume sweep for Filippo Arena
note: COMPLETE AND NEGATIVE. Forty acts, no Tavola, VOLUME TARLATO. Grooms in order: Russo, d'Amico, Barbaro, Camburini, Catalano, Catalano, Martelletti, Giaffone, Vita, Benedetto, Morabito, Barbaro, Fama, Vincenti, Filano, Scarroni, di Franco, Brancati, Lagana, Sofi, Bellantone, Migliorino, Pizzarello, Martello, Porcaro, Bellantone, Micollica, Chirico, Napoli, Caviola, Falco, Martelletti, Lico, Puglisi, Cardillo, Costa, Vazzani, La Rosa, Bellantoni, Barbaro. Act 41 is struck and act 42 a blank form, so the volume is closed and the reading is whole, not partial. NO ARENA. The surname list is this archive's reading of forty hands and some entries are uncertain; what is NOT uncertain is that none of the forty is Arena, a name written the same way throughout this series.

name: volume sweep for Filippo Arena
note: COMPLETE AND NEGATIVE. Thirty-nine acts, no Tavola, VOLUME TARLATO. Grooms in order: Cardone, Lanzera, Marfea, Sala, Martello, Lagani, Calarco, Vizzari, Morena, Mittiga, Nicolo, Polimene, Bellantone, Pirro, Migliorino, Lapadia, Barbaro, Costa, Alfonzetti, Trecroci, Marzano, Puleo, de Amico, Pizzarello, Polifroni, Mansone, Zangla, Longordo, Torace, Bellantone, Bellantone, Barbaro, Papalia, Pirrotta, Fusco, d'Elia, Vita, Benedetto, Vita. Act 40 carries the closing statement of 31 December 1817 and act 41 is a blank form, so the volume is closed. NO ARENA. The surname list is this archive's reading and some entries are uncertain; the negative is not.

name: Filippo Arena x Domenica Costa -- the marriage file
father: Orazio Arena; Giovanni de Costa (d. 1790), son of the late Giuseppe and Giacoma Turco
note: THREE LEAVES, AND THEY REACH BACK TO 1787, 1790 AND 1793. The wrapper reads «1815 | 114 a 116 | N.o 29 | Scilla | Documenti per il Matrimonio di FILIPPO ARENA E DOMENICA COSTA | fogli tre», images 149-152 of container LqA4a7D. Folio 114: Filippo's baptism, «Die vigesima quinta mensis Martii Anno Domini millesimo septingentesimo nonagesimo tertio, Scyllae ... infantem HODIE NATUM ex HORATIO ARENA et LITTERIA MORABITO coniugibus, cui nomen imposuit PHILIPPUS NUNTIATUS», baptised by Rev. D. Rocco Cantore del'Amico under licence, godmother Rosaria Bombarda. Folio 115: Domenica's baptism, 16 June 1787, «infantem hodie natam ex JOANNE DE COSTA et MARTHA ALFONZETTI coniugibus, cui imposui nomen DOMINICA JOSEPHA», by the archpriest Giuseppe Ingigneri himself, godmother Giuseppa Cotronei. Folio 116: Giovanni's death, 29 March 1790, aged about forty, «FILIUS QUONDAM JOSEPHI ET JACOBAE TURCO, legitimus vir Marthae Alfonzetti», confessed to Rev. D. Paolo Turco, given the Viaticum, anointed, and buried in the church of S. Maria di Porto Salvo. All three copied by Leonardo Cantore Bandiera, economo curato, in May and October 1815.

name: volume sweep for Arena and Donato
note: COMPLETE. Scilla's FIRST YEAR of civil marriage, twenty-five acts on the napoleonic printed form, one act to an opening, act = image - 2; images 26-27 are blank forms. The form names the groom, his age, his trade, his parents AND THE BRIDE, so one crop reads both spouses. Grooms in order: Gulli, Fiore, Bova, Chillino, Bueti, Sgarlato, Morabito, Vazzari, Ficarra, Costa, di Costa, Romano, Bellantoni, Macri, di Franco, Martelletti, Morabito, Lorenzo, Marcelli, Martello, Ficara, Cesario, di Giuseppe, Labruzzo, Catalano. NO ARENA GROOM AND NO DONATO GROOM. Two names to keep: act 2 marries FORTUNATA DONATO and act 10 marries GIACOMA ARENA -- both brides, both in the first year of the register.

name: volume sweep for Arena and Donato
note: COMPLETE, AND IT HOLDS AN ARENA. Two years in one volume, forty-four acts, one to an opening, act = image - 2; the sindaco's closing statement on image 47 gives the count and images 45-46 are blank forms. Act 1 is a MORABITO, molinaro, forty-five, whose page is cropped and water-damaged and had to be re-cropped wider. NO DONATO GROOM in either year. ACT 21 IS DIEGO ARENA -- see the row below.

name: Diego Arena x Maria Giuseppa Pontillo
father: Domenico Arena, 70, BARBIERE; Giovanni Pontillo, 42, commerciante
note: THE EARLIEST-BORN ARENA IN THIS ARCHIVE. 12 August 1813, before Giacomo Minasi, sindaco. «DIEGO ARENA, di anni TRENTASETTE, di professione SARTORE, domiciliato in detto Comune, FIGLIO MAGGIORE DI DOMENICO ARENA, DI ANNI SETTANTA, DI PROFESSIONE BARBIERE, domiciliante in questo Comune, E DI ANNA MELIDONI, di anni cinquantaquattro», both present and consenting. The bride is MARIA GIUSEPPA PONTILLO, SIXTEEN, «figlia minore assistita da Giovanni Pontillo suo padre, di anni quarantadue, di professione commerciante, e di Diana Idone». Banns published at CAMPO as well as Scilla. SO DOMENICO ARENA WAS BORN ABOUT 1743 -- earlier than any Arena this archive holds, Orazio included -- and he is a BARBER, not a sailor. NOTHING JOINS HIM TO FILIPPO'S HOUSEHOLD and nothing here should be read as doing so: Scilla has more than one Arena family and this archive has already been caught once by a shared given name.

name: annual index read WHOLE, both spouses named
note: TWENTY-THREE MARRIAGES, alphabetised by the GROOM'S GIVEN NAME, and the index names BOTH SPOUSES. A: Ferraro x Calarco, Bellantoni x Barresi, Bova x Andaloro, Sisi x d'Amico, Fuca x Barresi. C: Corro Weingarten x Mariangela Giove -- ONE ENTRY, and it is not a Candeloro. F: Lagana x Chirmi, Vita x Arlotta, Martello x Sivarrone, Carlillo x Sfonari, La Bozzetta x Catalano. G: Pirrotta x Delfino, Giunne x Romano, Greno x Romano. M: Papalia x Caniola. P: Morabito x Martello, Bova x Aragona, Scarfone x Bellantone. S: Romano x Paladino. V: Prinei x Lagaia, Genforte x Paladino, Papalia x Boete, Musa x Cappillieri. NO DONATO AND NO ARENA, on either side.

name: annual Tavola read WHOLE, both spouses and all four parents
note: TWENTY-THREE MARRIAGES on the six-column form -- Num d'ordine, Sposi, Patria, GENITORI, Giorno, Osservazioni -- alphabetised by the groom's given name and certified «Per estratto conforme, Scilla 31 Xbre 1811». THE C SECTION IS ONE LINE: Candido Giordano x Marilina Sofi. NO CANDELORO DONATO, AND NO DONATO ANYWHERE, spouse or parent. TWO ARENA AS MOTHERS: Francesco Arbitrio is son of Domenico and NATALINA ARENA (13 7bre), and Giuseppa Falcomata is daughter of Domenico and FU ANTONIA ARENA (20 Febbraio). Also here, and already in this archive: Giovanni Vilardi x CANDIDA COSTA, «Rocco, e Pasqualina Idone», 14 9bre -- the entry that first gave Maria Costa's sister.

name: annual Tavola read WHOLE, both spouses and all four parents
note: SEVENTEEN MARRIAGES, same form, closed «Scilla 31 Dicembre 1812, Il Sindaco». NO DONATO ANYWHERE. ONE ARENA BRIDE: act 10, GIOVANNA ARENA, daughter of CARLO ARENA and EUGENIA ATEJA, marries Giovanni La Mussa on 6 Gennaro. And act 1 marries NUNZIATA FALCOMATA, daughter of Domenico and «fu ANTONIA ARENA» -- the same dead Antonia Arena whose other daughter married in 1811, so the two entries are one household and she died before 1811.

name: annual Tavola, A section -- TWO ARENA GROOMS
note: ALPHABETISED BY SURNAME, so Arena sits at the top of the book. THREE ENTRIES UNDER A: [Ac]curso Francesco of Cannitello x Pizzarello Giuseppa (act 16); ARENA ROCCO x COSTA DOMENICA, parents «... Prato, e Vittoria Fiorenza» and «Giovan Mariano, ed Angela Brigante» (act 20, 10 Giugno); and ARENA GIUSEPPE x POLISTINA MARIA TERESA, parents «ORAZIO, e LITTERIA MORABITO» and «fu Raffaele, e Vittoria Morabito» (act 29, 13 9bre). THE SECOND OF THOSE IS FILIPPO ARENA'S BROTHER, and the Tavola alone would have been enough: «Orazio, e Litteria Morabito», no «fu» on either, is Filippo's own parentage and dates them both alive.

name: Giuseppe Arena x Maria Teresa Polistina
father: Orazio Arena, marinaro; Raffaele Polistina, defonto
note: FILIPPO ARENA'S BROTHER, READ IN THE ORIGINAL. The solenne promessa of 7 November 1821 before TOMMASO CUTELLI, sindaco -- the same sindaco who married Filippo in 1815. «GIUSEPPE ARENA, di anni VENTISETTE, nato in questo Comune, di professione MARINARO, domiciliato ivi, FIGLIO DI ORAZIO ARENA, di professione MARINARO, domiciliato ivi, E DI LITTERIA MORABITO, domiciliata ivi. E MARIA TERESA POLISTINA, d'anni VENTUNO, nata in questo Comune, figlia di RAFAELE POLISTINA, DEFONTO, e di [Litteria] MORABITO, DEFONTA.» The INDICAZIONE column records the church celebration «nel giorno TREDICI del mese di Novembre anno corrente». THREE THINGS AT ONCE: a brother for Filippo; ORAZIO AND LITTERIA ALIVE ON 7 NOVEMBER 1821, six years past the only other date for them; and LITTERIA confirmed a THIRD time, after the 1815 marriage act and the baptism extract in the 1815 bundle. ONE DISCREPANCY RECORDED, NOT RESOLVED: the Tavola gives the bride's mother as VITTORIA Morabito and the act appears to read LITTERIA Morabito, defonta -- the same name as the groom's living mother. Two women of that name, or a clerk's eye slipping up a line; the act is the better witness but the doubt is real.
